listening.trapExplanationVi: [thường gặp] rect-ang-ular

listening.audioText: The archaeology museum is open to school groups for thirteen days this month.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Phân biệt -teen (nhấn âm cuối, nguyên âm dài /iː/) với thirty (nhấn âm đầu).

listening.audioText: Participants must arrive at least thirty minutes prior to the listening exam.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Nhấn âm đầu THIR-ty, âm cuối ngắn /i/, khác với thir-TEEN.

listening.audioText: The marine survey collected water samples from fourteen coastal monitoring stations.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Có chữ u trong fourteen (khác forty không có u) và nhấn âm cuối.

listening.audioText: The refurbished auditorium can now accommodate forty additional researchers.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Viết forty (KHÔNG có chữ u như four/fourteen); nhấn âm đầu.

listening.audioText: A late fee of fifteen pounds applies if library books are returned overdue.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Nghe kỹ âm /n/ cuối và trọng âm rơi vào -TEEN để không nhầm với fifty.

listening.audioText: Approximately fifty percent of respondents commuted by public transport.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Trọng âm ở FIF-ty, không có âm mũi /n/ ở cuối như fifteen.

listening.audioText: The exhibition runs for sixteen weeks in the north wing of the gallery.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết thứ hai -TEEN; dễ nhầm với sixty khi nói nhanh.

listening.audioText: The coach journey from the campus to the nature reserve takes sixty minutes.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Nhấn âm đầu SIX-ty, âm cuối /ti/ gọn hơn so với six-TEEN.

listening.audioText: Volunteers planted seventeen native oak saplings along the river embankment.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Nhấn mạnh âm cuối -TEEN và kéo dài âm /iː/.

listening.audioText: Over seventy volunteers signed up to monitor migratory birds this winter.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Nhấn âm đầu SEV-en-ty; chú ý tốc độ đọc nhanh trong IELTS Section 1.

listening.audioText: Applicants must be at least eighteen years old to join the overseas fieldwork.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Chỉ có 1 chữ t (eight + een -> eighteen), nhấn mạnh âm cuối.

listening.audioText: The research vessel sailed eighty nautical miles off the western coast.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Nhấn âm đầu EIGH-ty; dễ nhầm với eighteen trong âm thanh nối.

listening.audioText: The botanical survey catalogued nineteen rare orchid species in the valley.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Giữ chữ e sau nine (nine + teen), nhấn âm cuối -TEEN.

listening.audioText: Nearly ninety percent of the survey cohort completed the follow-up interview.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Giữ chữ e (ninety, không viết ninty); phân biệt với nineteen.

listening.audioText: The scholarship deadline has been extended to the twelfth of October.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Biến đổi ve -> f trước th: twelfth (không viết twelveth hoặc twelth).

listening.audioText: Major architectural reforms reshaped European cities during the twentieth century.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Đổi y thành ie rồi thêm th: twent-ie-th (không viết twentyth).

listening.audioText: The theatre is celebrating its fortieth anniversary with a special festival.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Không có chữ u (fortieth, không phải fourtieth).

listening.audioText: Steam railways expanded rapidly throughout the nineteenth century.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Giữ e trong nineteen trước khi thêm th.

listening.audioText: The guided audio tour starts promptly at quarter past ten each morning.
listening.meaningVi: hơn mười lăm phút (15 phút sau giờ chẵn)
listening.trapExplanationVi: Quarter past ten = 10:15, khác hoàn toàn với quarter to ten (9:45).

listening.audioText: Please assemble outside the main gate at quarter to eight for the bus.
listening.meaningVi: kém mười lăm phút (15 phút trước giờ chẵn)
listening.trapExplanationVi: Quarter to eight = 7:45; bẫy rất phổ biến ở Section 1.

listening.audioText: Library loans for postgraduate students last for a fortnight and can be renewed.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Từ Anh-Anh chỉ 2 tuần (fourteen nights); hay bị nghe nhầm thành four nights.

listening.audioText: The swimming pool closes early for maintenance every Tuesday evening.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Dễ nghe nhầm với Thursday khi người nói phát âm nhanh âm đầu.

listening.audioText: Tuition invoices for the winter term are issued in early January.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Viết đủ u-a-r-y (Jan-u-ary), tránh viết thiếu chữ u.

listening.audioText: Fieldwork in the northern highlands takes place throughout August.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Chú ý cụm au- đầu từ; tránh nhầm với October trong âm nối.

listening.audioText: All incoming first-year students must register by the third of September.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Viết đầy đủ Sep-tem-ber, không viết tắt Sept trong bài thi nghe.

listening.audioText: The annual film festival returns to the civic hall in mid-November.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Phân biệt rõ với September và December khi nghe số tháng.

listening.audioText: Online essay submissions must be uploaded to the portal before midnight.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Viết liền một từ; bẫy nghe nhầm với midday (12:00 trưa).

listening.audioText: Solar energy costs fell by more than eighty percent over the past decade.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Decade = 10 năm; bẫy đánh lừa với century (100 năm) hoặc fortnight (2 tuần).

listening.audioText: Satellite imagery shows that the desert boundary has expanded southward.
listening.trapExplanationVi: 1 chữ s (desert = sa mạc, nhấn âm 1); khác dessert (2 chữ s = món tráng miệng).

listening.audioText: The conference banquet includes a seasonal fruit dessert and herbal tea.
listening.trapExplanationVi: 2 chữ s, nhấn âm 2 /dɪˈzɜːt/; rất dễ nhầm chính tả với desert.

listening.audioText: Students can purchase notebooks and exam stationery at the campus shop.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Đuôi -ery (e = envelope/paper); đồng âm hoàn toàn với stationary (đứng yên).

listening.audioText: Traffic remained completely stationary along the ring road for nearly an hour.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Đuôi -ary (a = at rest); đồng âm với stationery (văn phòng phẩm).

listening.audioText: The college principal welcomed incoming scholars at the opening ceremony.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Đuôi -pal (người đứng đầu hoặc chính); đồng âm với principle (nguyên tắc).

listening.audioText: The design is based on a simple thermodynamic principle discovered in 1824.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Đuôi -ple (luật/quy tắc); đồng âm với principal (hiệu trưởng).

listening.audioText: Rising ocean acidity can severely affect the growth of coral skeletons.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Thường là động từ; dễ nhầm với danh từ effect trong câu điền từ.

listening.audioText: Researchers measured the cooling effect of street trees across forty cities.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Thường là danh từ (sau mạo từ the/an); dễ nhầm với động từ affect.

listening.audioText: Arctic foxes adapt to freezing winters by growing thicker white fur.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Có chữ a (adapt = thích nghi); dễ nghe nhầm với adopt (nhận nuôi/áp dụng).

listening.audioText: Several municipal councils plan to adopt electric buses before 2030.
listening.meaningVi: áp dụng, thông qua; nhận nuôi
listening.trapExplanationVi: Âm /ɒ/ (adopt = áp dụng); dễ nhầm với adapt (thích nghi).

listening.audioText: Practical laboratory sessions complement the theoretical lectures each week.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Chữ e (comple-ment = complete); đồng âm với compliment (lời khen).

listening.audioText: The visiting professor paid a warm compliment to the student research team.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Chữ i (compli-ment = khen); đồng âm với complement (bổ sung).

listening.audioText: The local city council approved funding for three new community parks.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Đuôi -cil (cơ quan hành chính); đồng âm với counsel (cố vấn/lời khuyên).

listening.audioText: Career advisors offer confidential counsel to graduates seeking employment.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Đuôi -sel (lời khuyên/luật sư tư vấn); đồng âm với council (hội đồng).

listening.audioText: Archaeologists discovered bronze tools near the ancient burial site.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Đồng âm với sight (thị giác/cảnh đẹp) và cite (trích dẫn).

listening.audioText: Academic writers must accurately cite every external source they consult.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Đồng âm với site (địa điểm) và sight (tầm nhìn).

listening.audioText: Coastal erosion often leaves behind layers of coarse gravel and shells.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Đồng âm hoàn toàn với course (khóa học/dòng chảy).

listening.audioText: Strict quality checks ensure that drinking water meets national safety standards.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Bắt đầu bằng en- (đảm bảo); dễ nhầm với insure (mua bảo hiểm).

listening.audioText: Walkers should watch out for loose stones along the steep mountain path.
listening.trapExplanationVi: 2 chữ o, âm cuối vô thanh /s/; dễ nhầm với động từ lose (/luːz/).

listening.audioText: The reading room on the upper level is reserved for quiet individual study.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Đuôi -et (2 âm tiết /ˈkwaɪ.ət/); rất hay viết nhầm thành quite (khá).

listening.audioText: Unpredictable mountain weather delayed the geological survey by two days.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Đồng âm với whether (liệu rằng); chú ý có chữ a sau e.

listening.audioText: Reading essays aloud can help learners detect awkward phrasing and rhythm.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Đồng âm với allowed (được phép); hay gặp trong Listening Section 3.

listening.audioText: Cyclists should test their front brake before riding down wet hills.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Đồng âm với break (nghỉ giải lao / làm vỡ).

listening.audioText: Safety harnesses must be fastened securely around the climber's waist.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Đồng âm với waste (rác thải / lãng phí).

listening.audioText: The inspector conducted a thorough review of the laboratory fire exits.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Dễ nhầm chính tả và phát âm với through (xuyên qua).

listening.audioText: Modern consumers are increasingly conscious of the environmental footprint of clothing.
listening.meaningVi: có ý thức, nhận thức rõ
listening.trapExplanationVi: Tính từ đuôi -scious; dễ nhầm với danh từ conscience (lương tâm).

listening.audioText: Tourists are advised not to wander off the marked trails in the reserve.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Có chữ a (/ˈwɒndə/); dễ nhầm với wonder (tự hỏi / kỳ quan).

listening.audioText: Heavy grazing stripped the hillside bare, accelerating topsoil erosion.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Đồng âm với bear (con gấu / chịu đựng).

listening.audioText: Open-ended interview questions tend to elicit far richer responses from participants.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Bắt đầu bằng e- (khơi gợi); dễ nhầm với illicit (bất hợp pháp).

listening.audioText: Please contact the admissions office if you require any further information.

listening.audioText: Plant-based alternatives now compete directly with traditional dairy products.

listening.audioText: Volunteers kept a detailed food diary for fourteen consecutive days.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Chữ i đứng trước a (di-ary); dễ viết nhầm thành dairy (sữa).

listening.audioText: Tall copper rods protect historic church spires from direct lightning strikes.
listening.trapExplanationVi: KHÔNG có chữ e ở giữa (lightning = sét; lightening = làm sáng/nhẹ đi).

listening.audioText: Deep breathing exercises help speakers steady their breath before presenting.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Không có chữ e cuối (danh từ /breθ/); khác động từ breathe (/briːð/).

listening.audioText: Recent advances in radar scanning have transformed modern field archaeology.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Có cụm aeo (arch-aeo-logy); cực hay xuất hiện trong Listening Section 4.

listening.audioText: Marine algae absorb carbon dioxide through the process of photosynthesis.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Ghép photo + synthesis (ph đọc /f/, syn dùng chữ y).

listening.audioText: Protecting wetland corridors is vital for preserving regional biodiversity.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Ghép bio + diversity; chú ý viết liền không dấu gạch nối.

listening.audioText: Rapid tropical deforestation reduces rainfall and destabilises local soils.
listening.trapExplanationVi: 1 chữ r (de-forest-ation), tránh nhầm thành deforrestation.

listening.audioText: Urban planners are prioritising long-term sustainability over short-term cost.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Chú ý sustain-ability (ai trước n, đuôi -ability không phải -ibility).

listening.audioText: Heavy investment in rail infrastructure eased commuter congestion dramatically.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Ghép infra + structure; hay bị thiếu chữ r đầu tiên (infastructure).

listening.audioText: Coding and media literacy have recently been added to the national curriculum.
listening.trapExplanationVi: 2 chữ r, 1 chữ l, đuôi -um (cur-ric-u-lum).

listening.audioText: Field measurements were collected to test the team's initial hypothesis.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Dùng y ở âm 1 (hy-poth-e-sis); số nhiều là hypotheses.

listening.audioText: The summer excavation uncovered pottery fragments dating back three millennia.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Bắt đầu bằng ex-ca- (ex-ca-vation), tránh thiếu chữ c.

listening.audioText: Artificial city lights can disorient songbirds during their nocturnal migration.
listening.trapExplanationVi: Khác với immigration (nhập cư) và emigration (di cư ra nước ngoài).

listening.audioText: Layers of river sediment preserve pollen grains from ancient forests.

passages.title: Urban Trees Cool Cities More Than Expected, Yet Limits Remain
paragraphs: Across rapidly expanding metropolitan areas, dark asphalt roads and dense concrete towers intensify the urban heat island effect, leaving city centres noticeably warmer than surrounding rural landscapes. A large international study recently revealed that street trees counteract extreme summer heat far more effectively than researchers had previously anticipated.

Urban greenery lowers neighbourhood temperatures through two complementary mechanisms. First, a dense tree canopy shields pavements and facades from direct solar radiation. Second, leaves release moisture into the air via transpiration, drawing thermal energy away from nearby streets. However, cooling performance varies sharply by climate: trees deliver strong relief in dry, temperate cities, whereas their evaporative benefit declines significantly in hot, humid conditions.

Despite these encouraging results, scientists caution against treating tree planting as a standalone solution to escalating global temperatures. Existing urban forests offset only a modest fraction of human-driven warming. Even the most ambitious municipal planting programmes require decades to mature and must therefore be paired with reflective roofs, shaded corridors, and rapid reductions in carbon emissions.

passages.title: Why Screen Time Guidelines Are Moving Beyond Strict Daily Limits
paragraphs: For years, paediatric bodies treated digital media as a single monolith, advising parents simply to count the hours children spent facing a screen. Today, mounting developmental research paints a far more multifaceted picture, prompting official advice to diverge sharply from rigid time caps.

Psychologists emphasise that passive scrolling at midnight affects teenagers very differently from collaborative coding or video calling distant grandparents. While excessive device use can certainly curb physical activity and crowd out sleep or face-to-face play, strict one-size-fits-all bans frequently backfire. Overly controlling restrictions may undermine adolescents' growing sense of autonomy and push unhealthy habits out of sight rather than resolving them.

Consequently, contemporary guidelines prioritise active parental mediation over blanket prohibition. Instead of policing a stopwatch, adults are encouraged to discuss online content, establish screen-free meal and bedtime routines, and recognise that children closely emulate the digital habits they observe at home. When parents put their own phones away during family conversations, young people develop healthier self-regulation naturally.

passages.title: Lessons From Australia's Four-Day Work Week Trial
paragraphs: Nearly a century ago, economist John Maynard Keynes predicted that technological progress would deliver a fifteen-hour working week. Although that vision never materialised, rapid advances in artificial intelligence have revived debate over how societies should redistribute future productivity gains equitably rather than allowing automation simply to displace human staff.

In a recent six-month trial, fifteen Australian organisations grappling with workplace burnout moved to a four-day week without reducing salaries. To gauge whether the model succeeded, researchers tracked revenue, staff attrition, sick leave, and overall absenteeism alongside employee wellbeing surveys. Most participating firms maintained or exceeded previous output by streamlining unnecessary meetings and protecting uninterrupted focus hours.

Despite overwhelmingly positive feedback from managers and workers alike, researchers urge careful interpretation of the results. Companies volunteering for such pilots are rarely typical of the wider economy, and self-reported wellbeing scores carry a clear risk of bias. Expanding shortened schedules into hospitals, hospitality, and round-the-clock manufacturing will demand far more creative rostering than office trials alone.

passages.title: Ultra-Processed Foods and Bowel Cancer: A Closer Look at the Evidence
paragraphs: Headlines frequently link ultra-processed foods to chronic illness, yet earlier epidemiological studies produced inconsistent findings regarding bowel cancer incidence. One explanation is that grouping every packaged food together can mask major nutritional differences between wholegrain breakfast cereals and reconstituted meat products such as sausages or deli slices.

In a large longitudinal cohort, researchers analysed dietary questionnaires alongside medical records to examine whether swapping just ten percent of ultra-processed intake for minimally processed whole foods altered cancer risk. To verify how accurately the questionnaire could capture real eating habits, a subset of participants also completed detailed multi-day food diaries. Even after statistical models accounted for smoking, exercise, and body mass, higher intake of processed meats showed a clearer association with bowel cancer than total ultra-processed consumption alone.

Nevertheless, nutrition scientists remind the public to exercise caution when reading dramatic diet headlines. Because observational studies cannot definitively prove cause and effect, gradual shifts toward fibre-rich vegetables, legumes, and unprocessed proteins remain the most sensible preventive strategy.

passages.title: What Workers Actually Report About AI and Job Losses
paragraphs: Public debate around artificial intelligence has generated intense speculation, with pessimists warning of mass layoffs while optimists promise effortless prosperity. Yet until recently, labour economists lacked solid data capturing how ordinary employees were actually experiencing workplace automation.

To bridge this gap, a sociologist surveyed thousands of adult workers across multiple industries. Surprisingly, substantial job displacement caused directly by AI remained a rarity: only a tiny minority reported losing a position or having hours cut because of automated software. Far from triggering widespread unemployment, AI tools were mostly used to draft routine emails, summarise reports, or assist with coding tasks.

Still, the author notes two important caveats. First, any single survey offers only a temporary snapshot of a fast-moving technology. Second, online panels rely partly on self-selected respondents, which can skew estimates. Over the coming decade, automated systems could still render certain entry-level duties obsolete, making it harder for young graduates to climb the first rung of the career ladder.

passages.title: Assisted Evolution and the Race to Save Coral Reefs
paragraphs: Coral reefs cover less than one percent of the ocean floor, yet they sustain roughly a quarter of all marine species. Unfortunately, successive marine heatwaves have triggered severe bleaching events, causing corals to expel the symbiotic algae that supply both their colour and most of their energy.

In response, marine biologists are trialling a controversial intervention known as assisted evolution. Rather than waiting centuries for natural selection to act, scientists cross-breed heat-tolerant coral colonies from warmer lagoons with vulnerable reef populations and cultivate the resilient offspring in underwater nurseries. Early field deployments along the Great Barrier Reef indicate that selectively bred larvae survive elevated water temperatures markedly better than wild controls.

Critics nevertheless warn that laboratory-reared corals cannot replace comprehensive climate action. Introducing genetically narrowed stock risks reducing natural diversity and could inadvertently heighten vulnerability to novel pathogens. Most ecologists agree that reef restoration buys precious breathing space, but long-term survival still hinges on curbing global greenhouse gas emissions.

passages.title: Sleep Deprivation and the Hidden Cost to Cognitive Agility
paragraphs: Modern work cultures frequently glorify long hours and minimal rest, yet neuroscientists warn that chronic sleep deprivation silently erodes human judgement. Even losing ninety minutes of sleep per night over a single working week impairs prefrontal cortex activity, diminishing memory consolidation, emotional regulation, and creative problem-solving.

Alarmingly, sleep-deprived individuals are notoriously poor judges of their own decline. In controlled laboratory experiments, volunteers restricted to six hours of nightly rest reported feeling only mildly fatigued after ten days, even though their reaction times had deteriorated to levels comparable with staying awake for twenty-four hours straight. Caffeine temporarily masks drowsiness by blocking adenosine receptors, but it cannot replicate the cellular repair and metabolic waste clearance that occur exclusively during deep slow-wave sleep.

Public health researchers argue that treating rest as a personal indulgence rather than a biological necessity carries steep economic costs. Organisations that discourage late-night emails and schedule flexible shift rotations consistently report fewer safety incidents, stronger decision accuracy, and lower long-term burnout.

passages.title: Vertical Farming in Megacities: Promise and Practical Constraints
paragraphs: As urban populations swell and unpredictable droughts disrupt open-field harvests, vertical farming has attracted billions in venture capital. Inside converted warehouses, stacked trays of leafy greens grow under tuned LED lighting using closed-loop hydroponic systems that consume up to ninety-five percent less water than conventional agriculture while eliminating chemical runoff.

Because produce is harvested just kilometres from supermarkets, vertical farms slash refrigerated freight emissions and guarantee year-round supply regardless of seasonal storms. Leafy crops such as basil, spinach, and lettuce thrive in these sterile enclosures, delivering crisp textures and remarkably long shelf lives without synthetic pesticides.

Yet steep electricity bills remain the sector's Achilles' heel. Replicating natural sunlight artificially demands substantial power, making energy-intensive staple crops like wheat, rice, and maize economically unviable indoors. Until grids transition overwhelmingly to cheap renewable energy, agronomists view vertical farms not as a replacement for broadacre farmland, but as a resilient complement supplying fresh greens to dense metropolitan hubs.

passages.title: Unravelling Fast Fashion: Can Circular Textiles Scale Up?
paragraphs: Over the past two decades, global clothing production has roughly doubled while the average number of times a garment is worn before being discarded has plummeted. Fast-fashion retailers accelerate turnover through rapid micro-seasons, enticing shoppers with rock-bottom prices made possible by synthetic polyester fibres and tightly squeezed overseas supply chains.

This linear take-make-waste model carries an immense ecological toll. Textile dyeing contaminates freshwater rivers, synthetic garments shed microfibres during every wash, and less than one percent of discarded apparel is currently recycled into new clothing. Most donated garments are downcycled into insulation rags or exported to overstretched markets in developing economies.

Transitioning toward a circular textile economy requires redesigning apparel from the outset. Chemical recycling plants can now separate blended cotton-polyester fabrics into virgin-quality fibres, yet operating costs remain far higher than producing fresh petroleum-based yarn. Economists therefore contend that voluntary brand pledges will fall short unless governments enact extended producer responsibility laws that tax disposable overproduction and reward repairable, durable design.

passages.title: Bilingualism, Executive Control, and Lifelong Brain Plasticity
paragraphs: During the early twentieth century, many educators mistakenly assumed that raising children with two languages would cause mental confusion and delay academic progress. Modern neuroimaging has decisively overturned that assumption, revealing that juggling two linguistic systems continuously exercises the brain's executive control network.

Whenever a fluent bilingual speaks, both languages remain simultaneously active in the mind. Selecting the appropriate vocabulary while inhibiting interference from the non-target language strengthens attentional switching and working memory. Although bilingual toddlers sometimes display slightly smaller single-language vocabularies initially, their combined conceptual knowledge matches monolingual peers and their early gap soon disappears.

Even more striking are findings from clinical neurology. Several large hospital cohorts suggest that lifelong active bilinguals experience the onset of dementia symptoms roughly four to five years later than monolinguals with comparable levels of brain pathology. Researchers emphasise that bilingualism does not prevent physical ageing of the brain, but instead builds cognitive reserve—allowing neural pathways to compensate effectively when damage accumulates.

passages.title: Microplastics in Freshwater Systems: Tracking an Invisible Pollutant
paragraphs: Although oceanic garbage patches dominate public attention, freshwater ecologists stress that rivers and lakes act as both major conduits and long-term sinks for microplastics. Fragments smaller than five millimetres enter waterways primarily through tyre abrasion washed off highways, synthetic laundry effluent, and disintegrating agricultural mulch films.

Because their size closely resembles natural plankton, microplastics are readily ingested by freshwater invertebrates and juvenile fish. Laboratory assays demonstrate that trapped particles can induce false satiation, reducing nutrient intake and slowing larval growth. Furthermore, plastic surfaces behave like chemical magnets, adsorbing persistent heavy metals and industrial pesticides from polluted river water before transferring those toxins up the aquatic food web.

Filtering microscopic debris from entire river basins is practically impossible once dispersal occurs. Consequently, environmental engineers focus on upstream interception: installing fine-mesh filters inside domestic washing machines, constructing vegetated stormwater basins along motorways to trap tyre dust, and phasing out single-use packaging before fragments ever reach a tributary.

passages.title: Autonomous Vehicles: Congestion Cure or Catalyst for Urban Sprawl?
paragraphs: Proponents of autonomous vehicles long promised that self-driving fleets would banish traffic jams, slash accident fatalities, and free up vast downtown parking lots for parks and affordable housing. Because computer-guided cars can travel safely at tighter spacing and coordinate smoothly at intersections, engineers calculate that existing motorways could carry substantially more vehicles per hour.

Transport planners, however, highlight an overlooked paradox known as induced demand. If commuters can sleep, read, or answer emails effortlessly inside private driverless cars, the perceived cost of long daily journeys plummets. Many households would likely relocate to cheaper, distant suburbs, accelerating urban sprawl and actually multiplying total vehicle kilometres travelled. Empty 'zero-occupancy' cars cruising city blocks to avoid parking fees could worsen peak congestion even further.

Ultimately, technology alone will not determine whether driverless mobility improves urban liveability. Cities that integrate autonomous shuttles into high-capacity rail corridors and price single-occupant road space stand to reclaim greener streets; those that treat self-driving cars merely as chauffeured private sedans risk locking in heavier gridlock for decades.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: experts think → Bài: specialists argue

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: get rid of plastic waste → Bài: eliminate single-use plastics.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: run out of fossil fuels → Bài: exhaust non-renewable reserves.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: make traffic worse → Bài: exacerbate peak-hour congestion.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: make symptoms better → Bài: alleviate chronic discomfort.
paraphrases.explanationVi: alleviate thường đi với pain, poverty, congestion, symptoms.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: speed up recovery → Bài: accelerate economic recovery.
paraphrases.explanationVi: accelerate = speed up (cả nghĩa vật lý lẫn kinh tế/xã hội).

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: slow down innovation → Bài: impede technological progress.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: encourage creativity → Bài: foster creative thinking among pupils.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: ban smoking indoors → Bài: prohibit tobacco use in enclosed spaces.
paraphrases.explanationVi: prohibit / outlaw = ban chính thức bằng quy định hoặc pháp luật.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: allow visitors to take photos → Bài: permit photography without flash.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: keep experienced staff → Bài: retain skilled employees.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: throw away old electronics → Bài: discard obsolete devices.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: sell goods directly → Bài: retail products straight to consumers.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: build a new bridge → Bài: construct a suspension crossing.
paraphrases.explanationVi: construct / erect thường thay cho build trong mô tả bản đồ và kiến trúc.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: knock down the old factory → Bài: demolish the disused mill.
paraphrases.explanationVi: demolish / tear down là cặp paraphrase bắt buộc cho bài Map.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: improve the old theatre → Bài: renovate the historic auditorium.
paraphrases.explanationVi: renovate / refurbish = tân trang, sửa chữa công trình cũ.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: move the clinic → Bài: relocate the medical centre to the east wing.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: the campus grew → Bài: the university expanded its northern site.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: habitats are getting smaller → Bài: natural habitats are shrinking rapidly.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: predict future demand → Bài: forecast long-term electricity demand.
paraphrases.explanationVi: forecast / project dùng cho thời tiết, kinh tế và xu hướng tương lai.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: hide the real cost → Bài: conceal hidden administrative fees.
paraphrases.explanationVi: conceal / obscure trái nghĩa với reveal / disclose.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: tell customers about data use → Bài: disclose how personal data is shared.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: depend on imported oil → Bài: rely heavily on foreign fuel supplies.
paraphrases.explanationVi: rely on / hinge on là cách paraphrase phổ biến của depend on.

paraphrases.explanationVi: endorse mang nghĩa ủng hộ công khai một kế hoạch hoặc sản phẩm.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: scientists disagree with the claim → Bài: researchers challenge the assumption.
paraphrases.explanationVi: challenge a claim/theory = đặt nghi vấn, phản bác lập luận.

paraphrases.explanationVi: compensate for / offset = bù đắp tổn thất.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: waste public money → Bài: squander taxpayer funds on unused venues.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: protect endangered birds → Bài: safeguard vulnerable wetland species.
paraphrases.explanationVi: safeguard / preserve = bảo vệ khỏi nguy cơ tổn hại.

paraphrases.meaningVi: đặt vào tình thế nguy hiểm

paraphrases.explanationVi: jeopardise / threaten = gây nguy hại cho sự thành công hay an toàn.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: harm marine life → Bài: prove detrimental to coastal ecosystems.
paraphrases.explanationVi: be detrimental to = be harmful to (tính từ Band 8.0).

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: helpful for studying → Bài: a quiet atmosphere conducive to concentration.
paraphrases.explanationVi: conducive to = tạo môi trường thuận lợi cho việc gì xảy ra.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: a very big impact → Bài: an immense economic transformation.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: a very small difference → Bài: a negligible gap between the two groups.
paraphrases.explanationVi: negligible = quá nhỏ nên gần như không ảnh hưởng.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: safety is very important → Bài: passenger safety is of paramount importance.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: a minor, unimportant detail → Bài: a trivial administrative oversight.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: it is very clear that → Bài: it is readily evident from the data.
paraphrases.explanationVi: evident / apparent / unmistakable = rõ ràng.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: unclear instructions → Bài: ambiguous wording in the contract.
paraphrases.explanationVi: ambiguous = có thể hiểu theo nhiều nghĩa khác nhau.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: a surprising outcome → Bài: an unanticipated surge in enrolments.
paraphrases.explanationVi: unanticipated / unforeseen = không lường trước được.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: an expected reaction → Bài: a predictable seasonal decline.
paraphrases.explanationVi: predictable trái nghĩa với erratic / unpredictable.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: unusually high heat → Bài: unprecedented summer temperatures.
paraphrases.explanationVi: unprecedented = chưa từng xảy ra trước đây trong lịch sử.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: normal farming → Bài: conventional open-field agriculture.
paraphrases.explanationVi: conventional đối lập với innovative / alternative / experimental.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: a new method → Bài: a novel approach to battery recycling.
paraphrases.explanationVi: novel (adj) trong Reading nghĩa là mới mẻ và sáng tạo, không phải tiểu thuyết!

paraphrases.meaningVi: lỗi thời, không còn dùng nữa
paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: old-fashioned tools → Bài: equipment rendered obsolete by automation.
paraphrases.explanationVi: obsolete = lỗi thời vì đã có thứ mới hơn thay thế.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: the latest medical devices → Bài: cutting-edge diagnostic imaging.
paraphrases.explanationVi: cutting-edge / state-of-the-art = công nghệ tân tiến bậc nhất.

paraphrases.meaningVi: sơ khai, cơ bản ban đầu
paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: basic stone tools → Bài: rudimentary agricultural implements.
paraphrases.explanationVi: rudimentary hay gặp trong bài khảo cổ và lịch sử công nghệ.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: advanced tracking software → Bài: sophisticated satellite telemetry.
paraphrases.explanationVi: sophisticated mô tả hệ thống, công nghệ hoặc lập luận tinh vi.

paraphrases.explanationVi: inevitable = chắc chắn sẽ xảy ra, không tránh khỏi.

paraphrases.explanationVi: viable / feasible = có khả năng triển khai thành công trong thực tế.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: pointless efforts → Bài: a futile attempt to halt coastal erosion.
paraphrases.explanationVi: futile = incapable of producing any useful result.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: fair access to healthcare → Bài: equitable distribution of medical services.
paraphrases.explanationVi: equitable = fair and impartial.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: an unfair sample → Bài: a heavily biased online survey.
paraphrases.explanationVi: biased trái nghĩa với objective / impartial.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: strict safety rules → Bài: stringent environmental regulations.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: light punishments → Bài: lenient sentencing for first-time offenders.
paraphrases.explanationVi: lenient = ít khắt khe hơn dự kiến (thường dùng trong luật/giáo dục).

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: a sudden stop → Bài: an abrupt termination of funding.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: lasting cultural influence → Bài: an enduring architectural legacy.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: a common misconception → Bài: a prevalent belief among consumers.

paraphrases.explanationVi: localised đối lập với widespread / nationwide.

paraphrases.explanationVi: consumers dùng rộng trong kinh tế và tiếp thị.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: training all staff → Bài: upskilling an ageing workforce.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: native plant species → Bài: indigenous flora adapted to poor soils.
paraphrases.explanationVi: indigenous / native đối lập với non-native / invasive.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: harmful foreign weeds → Bài: invasive plant species crowding out native grass.
paraphrases.explanationVi: invasive species là thuật ngữ quen thuộc trong Reading sinh học.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: modern farming methods → Bài: intensive commercial agriculture.
paraphrases.explanationVi: agriculture / cultivation thay cho farming.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: big cities → Bài: densely populated urban centres.
paraphrases.explanationVi: urban / metropolitan đối lập với rural / pastoral.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: clinics in the countryside → Bài: healthcare access in remote rural regions.
paraphrases.explanationVi: rural = thuộc vùng nông thôn.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: long-term weather shifts → Bài: shifting regional climate patterns.
paraphrases.explanationVi: climate là thời tiết dài hạn; không nhầm với weather ngắn hạn.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: months without rain → Bài: a prolonged seasonal drought.
paraphrases.explanationVi: drought = thiếu mưa kéo dài gây khô hạn.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: polluted groundwater → Bài: aquifers contaminated by industrial runoff.
paraphrases.explanationVi: contaminated dùng cho nước, đất, thực phẩm bị nhiễm độc/vi khuẩn.

paraphrases.meaningVi: uống được, đạt chuẩn nước sạch

paraphrases.explanationVi: potable water = safe drinking water.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: household rubbish collection → Bài: municipal refuse management.
paraphrases.explanationVi: refuse (n. /ˈrefjuːs/) = rác thải sinh hoạt.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: wind and solar power → Bài: rapid investment in renewables.
paraphrases.explanationVi: renewables = renewable energy sources.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: minor health problems → Bài: common respiratory ailments.
paraphrases.explanationVi: ailment / disorder / malady thường thay cho illness.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: lifelong health issues → Bài: managing chronic cardiovascular conditions.
paraphrases.explanationVi: chronic (mãn tính) đối lập với acute (cấp tính).

paraphrases.meaningVi: phương thuốc, biện pháp khắc phục
paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: a simple treatment → Bài: an effective dietary remedy.
paraphrases.explanationVi: remedy dùng cho cả y học lẫn giải pháp xã hội.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: preventive medicine → Bài: prophylactic vaccination campaigns.
paraphrases.explanationVi: prophylactic / preventive = phòng bệnh hơn chữa bệnh.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: feeling very tired → Bài: acute mental fatigue among shift workers.
paraphrases.explanationVi: fatigue là từ học thuật chuẩn cho tiredness.

paraphrases.meaningVi: chế độ ăn / lượng nạp dinh dưỡng
paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: what people eat daily → Bài: participants' overall dietary intake.
paraphrases.explanationVi: dietary intake / nutrition thay cho eating habits.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: once a year → Bài: the university's annual sustainability audit.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: held every two years → Bài: a biennial international architecture summit.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: designed on purpose → Bài: deliberately engineered to resist corrosion.

paraphrases.contextSentence: Đề: almost zero emissions → Bài: virtually carbon-neutral operations.

upgrades.band6Sentence: The number of visitors went up a lot from 2 million to 5 million in 2010 to 2015.
upgrades.band8Sentence: The number of visitors rose sharply from 2 million to 5 million between 2010 and 2015.
upgrades.explanationVi: Kết hợp động từ 'rise' (nội động từ, quá khứ rose) + trạng từ 'sharply' chuẩn mô tả xu hướng Task 1.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Sales stayed the same at about 400 units until the end.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Sales remained stable at around 400 units for the rest of the period.
upgrades.explanationVi: 'remained stable at' là cụm chuẩn mực thay cho 'stayed the same'.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Unemployment got to the highest point of 12% in 2009 and then went down slowly.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Unemployment peaked at 12% in 2009 before declining steadily.
upgrades.explanationVi: Động từ 'peak at + số liệu' ngắn gọn, chính xác hơn 'get to the highest point'.

upgrades.band6Sentence: The price of solar panels went down very fast.
upgrades.band8Sentence: There was a dramatic fall in the price of solar panels.
upgrades.explanationVi: Cấu trúc danh từ hóa 'There was a + adj + noun + in' giúp đa dạng ngữ pháp Task 1.

upgrades.band6Sentence: The number went up and down between 30% and 40% for ten years.
upgrades.band8Sentence: The figure fluctuated between 30% and 40% throughout the decade.
upgrades.explanationVi: 'fluctuate between X and Y' diễn tả sự dao động chính xác thay cho 'go up and down'.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Car ownership went down to the lowest number of 15% in 1990.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Car ownership reached a low of 15% in 1990.
upgrades.explanationVi: 'reach a low of + số liệu' là collocation chuẩn cho điểm đáy biểu đồ.

upgrades.band6Sentence: The number was 45% in the year 2000.
upgrades.band8Sentence: The figure stood at 45% in 2000.
upgrades.explanationVi: 'stand at' là động từ học thuật tự nhiên để nêu mốc số liệu khởi điểm thay vì lặp 'was'.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Exports became more than two times bigger during the chart time.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Exports more than doubled over the period shown.
upgrades.explanationVi: Động từ 'double' kèm trạng ngữ 'more than' giúp diễn đạt bội số cực kỳ súc tích.

upgrades.band6Sentence: The recycled waste became almost three times more from 2000 to 2020.
upgrades.band8Sentence: The amount of waste recycled nearly tripled between 2000 and 2020.
upgrades.explanationVi: 'nearly tripled' súc tích hơn rất nhiều so với 'became almost three times more'.

upgrades.band6Sentence: The percentage of households with internet rose steadily. It reached 90% in 2020.
upgrades.band8Sentence: The percentage of households with internet access rose steadily, reaching 90% in 2020.
upgrades.explanationVi: Dùng mệnh đề phân từ V-ing (', reaching ...') để gộp hai câu đơn thành câu phức mượt mà.

upgrades.band6Sentence: The two lines met at the same point in 2015 at 60%.
upgrades.band8Sentence: The two lines converged in 2015, when both stood at 60%.
upgrades.explanationVi: 'converge' là từ chuyên dụng Band 8.0 chỉ hai đường biểu đồ tiến về cùng một điểm.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Electricity use will probably go up to 300 units in 2030.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Electricity consumption is projected to rise to 300 units by 2030.
upgrades.explanationVi: Khi biểu đồ có mốc tương lai, dùng 'is projected/forecast to + V' thay cho 'will probably'.

upgrades.band6Sentence: In general, coal was always the biggest source and renewables grew the most quickly.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Overall, it is clear that coal remained the main source of electricity, while renewables grew the fastest.
upgrades.explanationVi: Mở đoạn Overview bằng 'Overall, it is clear that...' giúp nổi bật xu hướng chính cho tiêu chí Task Achievement.

upgrades.band6Sentence: In the chart time, the biggest thing to notice is online sales grew fast.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Over the period shown, the most striking feature is the rapid growth of online sales.
upgrades.explanationVi: 'the most striking feature is...' là cấu trúc mở Overview tự nhiên, giàu sắc thái học thuật.

upgrades.band6Sentence: But on the other side, the percentage of older workers dropped a little.
upgrades.band8Sentence: By contrast, the proportion of older workers fell slightly.
upgrades.explanationVi: 'By contrast,' (hoặc 'In contrast,') là từ nối đối lập chuẩn xác ở đầu câu.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Meat eating went down, and vegetable eating went up.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Meat consumption fell, whereas vegetable consumption increased.
upgrades.explanationVi: Liên từ 'whereas' nối hai mệnh đề đối lập trong cùng một câu phức chuẩn ngữ pháp.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Healthcare spending was two times bigger than education spending.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Spending on healthcare was twice as high as spending on education.
upgrades.explanationVi: Cấu trúc so sánh bội số chuẩn: 'twice / three times as + adj + as'.

upgrades.band6Sentence: The number for men was a bit higher than the number for women.
upgrades.band8Sentence: The figure for men was slightly higher than that for women.
distractors: a little taller than those for
slightly more high than it for
upgrades.explanationVi: Dùng đại từ thay thế 'that for' (số ít) tránh lặp từ 'the figure for'.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Compared to 1990, much less people smoked in 2020.
upgrades.band8Sentence: In comparison with 1990, far fewer people smoked in 2020.
upgrades.explanationVi: 'In comparison with + N' kết hợp 'far fewer + danh từ đếm được số nhiều' cực chuẩn ngữ pháp.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Canada also has almost the same kind of chart.
upgrades.band8Sentence: A similar pattern can be seen in the data for Canada.
upgrades.explanationVi: 'A similar pattern can be seen in...' dùng để nhóm đối tượng có xu hướng tương đồng.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Japan had the biggest percent of old people, which was 28%.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Japan recorded the highest proportion of elderly people, at 28%.
upgrades.explanationVi: Động từ 'record' + giới từ 'at + số liệu' là bộ đôi nâng cấp điển hình trong Task 1.

upgrades.band6Sentence: About 24% of people in the survey liked online classes more.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Approximately a quarter of respondents (24%) preferred online classes.
upgrades.explanationVi: Quy đổi tỷ lệ phần trăm (~24-26%) sang phân số 'approximately a quarter of' giúp đa dạng từ vựng.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Almost all students (87%) used a laptop.
upgrades.band8Sentence: The vast majority of students (87%) used a laptop.
upgrades.explanationVi: 'The vast majority of' diễn tả tỷ lệ áp đảo (trên 80%) cực kỳ học thuật.

upgrades.band6Sentence: First, workers collect and sort the raw materials.
upgrades.band8Sentence: In the first stage of the process, raw materials are collected and sorted.
upgrades.targetChunk: In the first stage of the process,
distractors: At the starting step in process,
In step number one of making,
upgrades.explanationVi: Bài Process nên dùng bị động hiện tại đơn kèm cụm đánh dấu giai đoạn 'In the first stage of the process,'.

upgrades.band6Sentence: After people shape the clay, they put it into a hot oven.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Once the clay has been shaped, it is fired in a kiln.
upgrades.targetChunk: Once the clay has been shaped,
upgrades.explanationVi: Cấu trúc 'Once + S + has/have been + V3' thể hiện sự hoàn tất của bước trước trong bài Process.

upgrades.band6Sentence: The last step is workers put the product in boxes to send out.
upgrades.band8Sentence: The final stage involves packaging the product for delivery.
upgrades.explanationVi: 'involve + V-ing' giúp mô tả giai đoạn quy trình gọn gàng và chuẩn học thuật.

upgrades.band6Sentence: In the north of the village, they built a new group of houses.
upgrades.band8Sentence: To the north of the village, a new housing estate was constructed.
upgrades.explanationVi: 'To the north of' dùng cho vị trí nằm bên ngoài ranh giới; kết hợp bị động quá khứ 'was constructed'.

upgrades.band6Sentence: They took away the park and built a car park there.
upgrades.band8Sentence: The park was replaced by a car park.
upgrades.explanationVi: 'be replaced by' là cấu trúc bị động ngắn gọn chuẩn mực cho bài mô tả bản đồ.

upgrades.band6Sentence: The old school was changed to become a library.
upgrades.band8Sentence: The old school was converted into a library.
upgrades.explanationVi: 'be converted into' dùng chính xác khi giữ khung công trình cũ nhưng đổi công năng.

upgrades.band6Sentence: The road was made longer so it joined the town and the big highway.
upgrades.band8Sentence: The road was extended to connect the town with the motorway.
upgrades.explanationVi: Động từ 'extend' chuyên dùng cho đường sá, cầu cống, bến cảng được kéo dài trên bản đồ.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Technology has many benefits, but it can also make people lonely.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Although technology has many benefits, it can also isolate people.
upgrades.explanationVi: Dùng 'Although + mệnh đề' (không đi kèm 'but') để tạo câu phức nhượng bộ mạch lạc.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Some people say university should be free, and other people say students should pay.
upgrades.band8Sentence: While some argue that tuition should be free, others believe students should contribute.
upgrades.explanationVi: Mở bài dạng Discussion cực gọn và cân bằng bằng cấu trúc 'While some argue that..., others believe...'.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Cars are convenient, but also cars make air pollution.
upgrades.band8Sentence: On the one hand, cars offer convenience; on the other hand, they cause pollution.
upgrades.explanationVi: Cặp liên kết 'On the one hand... on the other hand' chuẩn mực khi phân tích hai mặt vấn đề.

upgrades.band6Sentence: I know that renewable energy costs a lot of money to set up.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Admittedly, renewable energy can be expensive to install.
upgrades.explanationVi: Trạng từ 'Admittedly,' mở câu nhượng bộ sắc sảo trước khi đưa lập luận phản biện.

upgrades.band6Sentence: But even so, saving money over a long time is very big.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Nevertheless, the long-term savings are considerable.
upgrades.explanationVi: 'Nevertheless,' là trạng từ liên kết đầu câu cực ăn khớp ngay sau câu nhượng bộ 'Admittedly,'.

upgrades.band6Sentence: I am not saying that old-style teaching is useless.
upgrades.band8Sentence: This is not to say that traditional teaching has no value.
upgrades.targetChunk: This is not to say that
upgrades.explanationVi: Cấu trúc 'This is not to say that...' làm mềm lập luận, tránh cực đoan — đặc trưng văn phong Band 8.0.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Different from what many people think, older workers often work better.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Contrary to popular belief, older workers are often more productive.
upgrades.explanationVi: 'Contrary to + cụm danh từ' là cụm chuyển ý phản bác quan niệm phổ biến rất tự nhiên.

upgrades.band6Sentence: This policy might reduce traffic. So the air will get cleaner.
upgrades.band8Sentence: This policy could reduce traffic. Consequently, air quality would improve.
upgrades.explanationVi: Dùng 'Consequently,' ở đầu câu thay cho 'So' để giữ văn phong trang trọng.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Because rents are going up, many young people still stay with their parents.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Due to rising rents, many young people still live with their parents.
upgrades.explanationVi: 'Due to + cụm danh từ' giúp câu súc tích hơn mệnh đề 'Because...'.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Because of machines doing work, lots of factory jobs are gone.
upgrades.band8Sentence: As a result of automation, many factory jobs have disappeared.
upgrades.explanationVi: 'As a result of + N' diễn đạt nguyên nhân khách quan, rất hợp chủ đề công nghệ và kinh tế.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Workers feel more motivated. And then this makes productivity higher.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Workers become more motivated. This, in turn, leads to higher productivity.
upgrades.explanationVi: Chuỗi nhân quả 'This, in turn, leads to...' cho thấy mạch phát triển ý sâu sắc (Coherence & Cohesion 8.0).

upgrades.band6Sentence: Exercise improves health, and also it can make people work better.
upgrades.band8Sentence: In addition to improving health, exercise can boost productivity.
upgrades.explanationVi: 'In addition to + V-ing/N' gọn gàng hơn việc nối bằng 'and also'.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Tourism creates jobs and it also helps cultural exchange.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Not only does tourism create jobs, but it also promotes cultural exchange.
upgrades.explanationVi: Đảo ngữ 'Not only + trợ động từ + S + V' nâng điểm Grammatical Range rõ rệt.

upgrades.band6Sentence: If governments put more money into buses and trains, fewer people would drive.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Were governments to invest more in public transport, fewer people would drive.
upgrades.explanationVi: Đảo ngữ câu điều kiện loại 2 'Were + S + to V' là cấu trúc giả định Band 8.0 kinh điển.

upgrades.band6Sentence: If they had started the policy sooner, many people would not have died.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Had the policy been introduced earlier, many lives could have been saved.
upgrades.explanationVi: Đảo ngữ điều kiện loại 3 kết hợp bị động 'Had + S + been + V3' cho thấy kiểm soát ngữ pháp đỉnh cao.

upgrades.band6Sentence: The thing that worries me most is how it affects children's mental health.
upgrades.band8Sentence: What concerns me most is the impact on children's mental health.
distractors: What is concerning me most are
upgrades.explanationVi: Câu chẻ (Wh-cleft sentence) 'What concerns me most is...' giúp nhấn mạnh trọng tâm lập luận.

upgrades.band6Sentence: How much technology makes learning better depends on how people use it.
upgrades.band8Sentence: The extent to which technology improves learning depends on how it is used.
upgrades.explanationVi: Cụm danh từ hóa 'The extent to which...' là dấu ấn học thuật chuẩn Cambridge Band 8.0.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Instead of making more roads, cities should make public transport better.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Rather than building more roads, cities should improve public transport.
upgrades.explanationVi: 'Rather than + V-ing' ở đầu câu nêu sự đối chiếu giải pháp cực sắc bén.

upgrades.band6Sentence: If people control it well, gene editing might cure many illnesses.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Provided that it is properly regulated, gene editing could cure many diseases.
upgrades.targetChunk: Provided that it is properly regulated,
distractors: Only if it is proper regulate,
upgrades.explanationVi: 'Provided that + mệnh đề' diễn tả điều kiện chặt chẽ thay cho 'If' lặp lại.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Many people say that university should not cost money.
upgrades.band8Sentence: It is often argued that university education should be free.
upgrades.explanationVi: Bị động khách quan 'It is often argued that...' mở đầu vấn đề học thuật trung lập.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Social media is definitely worse than it is good.
upgrades.band8Sentence: It could be argued that social media does more harm than good.
upgrades.explanationVi: Ngôn ngữ rào đón (hedging) 'It could be argued that...' tránh khẳng định cực đoan.

upgrades.band6Sentence: All young people spend more time on the internet than old people.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Young people tend to spend more time online than older generations.
upgrades.explanationVi: Động từ 'tend to + V' là công cụ rào đón đơn giản mà hiệu quả cao nhất trong Task 2.

upgrades.band6Sentence: In my thinking, the good points are bigger than the bad points.
upgrades.band8Sentence: From my perspective, the advantages outweigh the disadvantages.
upgrades.explanationVi: 'From my perspective,' tự nhiên và tránh lỗi giới từ 'According to me'.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Online learning has more good things than bad things.
upgrades.band8Sentence: The advantages of online learning outweigh its drawbacks.
upgrades.explanationVi: Collocation 'outweigh its drawbacks' là cụm vàng cho dạng đề Advantages/Disadvantages.

upgrades.band6Sentence: One good example is Singapore because buses and trains there are cheap and good.
upgrades.band8Sentence: A case in point is Singapore, where public transport is cheap and efficient.
upgrades.explanationVi: 'A case in point is + N' là cách đưa ví dụ điển hình tinh tế thay vì lặp 'For example'.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Like many Scandinavian countries give free university.
upgrades.band8Sentence: For instance, many Scandinavian countries offer free university education.
upgrades.explanationVi: 'For instance,' dùng chuẩn xác ở đầu câu thay cho 'Like' (vốn quá suồng sã).

upgrades.band6Sentence: Because of these problems, governments need to do something fast.
upgrades.band8Sentence: In light of these problems, governments must act quickly.
upgrades.explanationVi: 'In light of + N' (xét trước tình hình này) là cụm chuyển đoạn kết luận cực mượt.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Finally, both sides are kind of right, but I think education is most important.
upgrades.band8Sentence: In conclusion, while both views have merit, I believe education is the key.
upgrades.explanationVi: 'while both views have merit' tóm tắt sắc thái cân bằng trước khi chốt quan điểm cá nhân.

upgrades.band6Sentence: After looking at everything, putting money in schools is the best way to stop poverty.
upgrades.band8Sentence: All things considered, investing in education is the best long-term solution to poverty.
upgrades.explanationVi: 'All things considered,' là cụm mở đoạn kết luận tự nhiên và sang trọng.

upgrades.band6Sentence: The main reason is because people move to cities to get better jobs.
upgrades.band8Sentence: The main reason why people move to cities is to find better jobs.
upgrades.explanationVi: Tránh lỗi kinh điển 'The reason is because'; dùng 'The main reason why... is to V / that...'.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Smartphone sales grew very fast between 2012 and 2018.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Smartphone sales experienced rapid growth between 2012 and 2018.
upgrades.explanationVi: Danh từ hóa bằng 'experience + adj + noun' giúp đa dạng cấu trúc câu Task 1.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Coal usage dropped a lot after 2005.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Coal usage witnessed a steep decline after 2005.
upgrades.explanationVi: 'witness a steep decline' là collocation cực mượt khi miêu tả đường đi xuống mạnh.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Tourism numbers went up slowly over the next ten years.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Tourism numbers climbed steadily over the subsequent decade.
upgrades.explanationVi: 'climb steadily' + 'the subsequent decade' nâng cấp cả động từ lẫn cụm chỉ thời gian.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Oil prices dropped suddenly in 2020 and then went back up quickly.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Oil prices plummeted in 2020 before rebounding sharply.
upgrades.explanationVi: 'plummet' + 'before rebounding sharply' diễn tả biểu đồ hình chữ V cực đắt giá.

upgrades.band6Sentence: After 2010, the birth rate stopped changing and stayed flat.
upgrades.band8Sentence: After 2010, the birth rate plateaued at roughly 1.6 children per woman.
upgrades.explanationVi: Động từ 'plateau at' chuyên dùng khi đường biểu đồ đi ngang sau giai đoạn tăng/giảm.

upgrades.band6Sentence: The number of rail passengers dropped a little and then stayed the same.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Rail passenger numbers dipped slightly before levelling off.
upgrades.explanationVi: 'dip slightly' + 'levelling off' diễn tả cú giảm nhẹ rồi chững lại chuẩn xác.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Wind power went up very quickly from 5% to 35%.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Wind power surged sevenfold from 5% to 35%.
upgrades.explanationVi: Trạng từ bội số 'sevenfold' (gấp 7 lần) rất súc tích cho mô tả tỷ lệ.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Internet subscriptions got much bigger than landline phones in 2008.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Internet subscriptions overtook landline connections in 2008.
upgrades.explanationVi: Động từ 'overtake' (quá khứ overtook) chuyên dùng khi một đường vượt lên trên đường khác.

upgrades.band6Sentence: The gap between rich and poor regions got bigger every year.
upgrades.band8Sentence: The disparity between urban and rural incomes widened progressively.
upgrades.explanationVi: 'disparity' + 'widen progressively' nâng cấp hoàn toàn cho 'gap got bigger'.

upgrades.band6Sentence: The difference between men and women got smaller by 2020.
upgrades.band8Sentence: The gender gap narrowed considerably by 2020.
upgrades.explanationVi: 'narrow considerably' là collocation tự nhiên của 'gap'.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Gas consumption fell by half during the twenty-year period.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Gas consumption halved over the twenty-year timeframe.
upgrades.explanationVi: Động từ 'halve' (giảm một nửa) gọn hơn nhiều so với 'fell by half'.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Coffee exports rose a little bit from 100 to 108 tonnes.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Coffee exports edged upward marginally from 100 to 108 tonnes.
upgrades.explanationVi: 'edge upward marginally' mô tả mức tăng rất nhẹ cực kỳ tinh tế.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Attendance went up and down wildly throughout the winter.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Attendance exhibited erratic fluctuations throughout the winter.
upgrades.explanationVi: 'exhibit erratic fluctuations' dùng cho đường zic-zac biến động thất thường.

upgrades.band6Sentence: By 2018, bicycle use had gone back to its 2000 level.
upgrades.band8Sentence: By 2018, bicycle usage had returned to its original 2000 baseline.
upgrades.explanationVi: Thì quá khứ hoàn thành 'By + năm, S + had returned to...' tăng điểm ngữ pháp mạnh.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Solar output will probably reach 50% by 2040.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Solar output is anticipated to account for 50% of supply by 2040.
upgrades.explanationVi: 'be anticipated to account for' chuẩn mực cho dự báo tỷ trọng tương lai.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Housing took up 42% of the average household budget.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Housing accounted for 42% of average household expenditure.
upgrades.explanationVi: 'account for' là động từ hàng đầu thay cho 'take up' trong biểu đồ tròn (Pie chart).

upgrades.band6Sentence: Transport made up just under a fifth of total spending.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Transport constituted just under a fifth of total outlay.
upgrades.explanationVi: 'constitute' + phân số 'just under a fifth' (18–19%) giúp bài Pie chart giàu từ vựng.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Only a very small part (3%) came from nuclear power.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Nuclear power represented a negligible share, at merely 3%.
upgrades.explanationVi: 'represent a negligible share' nâng cấp câu mô tả phần tỷ trọng nhỏ nhất.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Food and rent together were more than half of all costs.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Combined, food and rent comprised well over half of total expenditure.
upgrades.explanationVi: 'Combined, ... comprised well over half' gộp hạng mục thông minh.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Almost two out of three residents used buses daily.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Roughly two-thirds of residents relied on bus services daily.
upgrades.explanationVi: Phân số 'two-thirds' nhớ có 's' ở mẫu số khi tử số lớn hơn 1.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Exactly half of the respondents were aged under thirty.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Precisely half of those surveyed fell into the under-thirty bracket.
upgrades.explanationVi: Cụm 'fall into the ... bracket' chuyên dùng để mô tả nhóm tuổi hoặc nhóm thu nhập.

upgrades.band6Sentence: France produced much more wine than Germany did.
upgrades.band8Sentence: France outstripped Germany by a wide margin in wine production.
upgrades.targetChunk: outstripped Germany by a wide margin

upgrades.band6Sentence: Finally, the bottles are checked and sent to shops.

upgrades.explanationVi: Dùng cho biểu đồ vòng đời tự nhiên (natural cycle): 'reproductive cycle', 'mature', 'migrate'.

upgrades.band6Sentence: The farmland on the west side was destroyed to build a shopping mall.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Farmland along the western flank was cleared to make way for a retail complex.

distractors: was broken to give place to

upgrades.explanationVi: 'undergo considerable expansion to accommodate...' diễn tả sự mở rộng cơ sở hạ tầng.

upgrades.band6Sentence: The railway station stayed in the same place the whole time.
upgrades.band8Sentence: The railway station remained unchanged throughout the entire twenty-year period.
upgrades.explanationVi: Bài Map luôn cần nêu ít nhất 1 chi tiết giữ nguyên bằng 'remained unchanged / intact'.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Trees were planted all around the edge of the sports centre.
upgrades.band8Sentence: The perimeter of the sports complex was lined with newly planted trees.
upgrades.explanationVi: 'perimeter ... was lined with' miêu tả hàng cây bao quanh rất chuẩn xác.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Sales rose to $5m in 2015, and this was the highest point.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Sales rose to $5 million in 2015, marking the highest point of the decade.

upgrades.targetChunk: Opinion remains sharply divided over whether

upgrades.band6Sentence: I completely agree with the idea that governments should tax sugary drinks.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Working from home always makes employees happier.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Social media destroys teenagers' mental health completely.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Excessive social media exposure can exert a detrimental influence on adolescent psychological wellbeing.
upgrades.explanationVi: 'exert a detrimental influence on' vừa học thuật vừa có độ rào đón ('can').

upgrades.band6Sentence: Banning cars in city centres will solve air pollution.

distractors: would go far way for cut

upgrades.band6Sentence: University degrees are useless now because of online courses.

upgrades.explanationVi: Trạng từ rào đón 'arguably' thể hiện tư duy phản biện sắc sảo.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Too much homework makes students stressed and tired.
upgrades.band8Sentence: An excessive academic workload can precipitate chronic stress and emotional burnout among pupils.
upgrades.explanationVi: Động từ 'precipitate' (châm ngòi, gây ra nhanh chóng) rất đắt giá trong bài nguyên nhân-hệ quả.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Bad public transport causes more traffic jams.

upgrades.explanationVi: 'drive X toward Y' mô tả cơ chế nhân quả hành vi rất tự nhiên.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Poor diets lead to higher hospital costs for the country.

upgrades.explanationVi: 'place an unsustainable strain on' là collocation Band 8.0 chuẩn cho áp lực ngân sách.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Cutting down forests makes climate change worse.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Unchecked deforestation accelerates greenhouse emissions, thereby compounding global climate instability.
upgrades.explanationVi: ', thereby + V-ing' nối kết quả tức thì trong cùng một câu cực mượt.

upgrades.band6Sentence: This problem happens because people lack financial education.

upgrades.explanationVi: 'stem primarily from' là động từ học thuật thay cho 'happen because of'.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Better childcare lets more mothers return to work.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Accessible childcare enables parents to re-enter the labour market, fostering broader economic growth.
upgrades.explanationVi: Mệnh đề phân từ ', fostering...' nối chuỗi hệ quả tự nhiên.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Even though electric cars are expensive, they save fuel over time.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Notwithstanding their steep upfront cost, electric vehicles deliver lower lifetime operating expenses.
distractors: Despite of their high first price,
In spite they cost high first,
upgrades.explanationVi: 'Notwithstanding + cụm danh từ' là dạng nhượng bộ trang trọng bậc cao.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Even if governments pass strict laws, some companies will still pollute.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Strict legislation alone, however well-intentioned, cannot eliminate corporate pollution without rigorous enforcement.
upgrades.explanationVi: Cấu trúc chêm ', however + adj,' tạo câu văn mạch lạc, sắc sảo.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Yes, tourism brings money, but it also damages old buildings.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Granted, mass tourism generates vital revenue; yet unchecked visitor numbers can erode fragile heritage sites.
upgrades.explanationVi: 'Granted, ...; yet ...' là cặp nhượng bộ – phản biện ngắn gọn, đầy uy lực.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Although AI helps doctors, it cannot replace human empathy.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Valuable though AI diagnostics may be, algorithms cannot replicate genuine human empathy.
upgrades.targetChunk: Valuable though AI diagnostics may be,
upgrades.explanationVi: Đảo tính từ lên đầu 'Adj + though/as + S + may be' là cấu trúc Band 8.5 ấn tượng.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Unlike rich nations, developing countries struggle to fund green energy.
upgrades.band8Sentence: In stark contrast to affluent nations, developing economies face acute capital constraints in financing clean energy.
upgrades.explanationVi: 'In stark contrast to' tạo sắc thái đối lập mạnh và chuẩn collocation.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Some workers love flexibility, while others feel lonely at home.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Whereas remote arrangements appeal to self-directed staff, they can leave newer employees feeling isolated.
upgrades.explanationVi: 'Whereas' mở đầu câu so sánh hai nhóm đối tượng mạch lạc.

upgrades.band6Sentence: We rarely see such rapid change in job markets.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Seldom have labour markets undergone such rapid structural transformation.
upgrades.explanationVi: Đảo ngữ trạng từ phủ định 'Seldom + have + S + V3' giúp nâng tầm ngữ pháp.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Society can solve this crisis only by working together.

upgrades.explanationVi: Đảo ngữ 'Only through + N + modal + S + V' cực hợp đoạn giải pháp/kết luận.

upgrades.band8Sentence: Should municipalities fail to modernise drainage networks, seasonal flooding will intensify.
upgrades.explanationVi: Đảo ngữ điều kiện loại 1 'Should + S + V' trang trọng hơn 'If...'.

The more longer life grows, heavier

upgrades.band6Sentence: Because they lack affordable homes, young couples delay having kids.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Technology can close the gap between rural and city schools.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Art and music should not be cut from school timetables.
upgrades.band8Sentence: Creative disciplines merit a permanent place within the core secondary curriculum.
upgrades.explanationVi: Động từ 'merit' (xứng đáng có được) rất tinh tế trong văn nghị luận.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Punishing criminals harshly does not always stop them from offending again.

upgrades.band6Sentence: People are losing touch with local traditions because of global media.

upgrades.band6Sentence: Also, green spaces help people feel less stressed.

upgrades.band6Sentence: To sum up, both parents and schools must teach kids online safety.

errorFixes.sentenceWithError: According to the chart, the United Kingdom spent more on rail than the France.

errorFixes.sentenceWithError: Students who study abroad gain valuable experience and an unique cultural outlook.

errorFixes.sentenceWithError: The internet has become indispensable tool for modern academic research.
errorFixes.fullCorrectSentence: The internet has become an indispensable tool for modern academic research.
errorFixes.explanationVi: Danh từ số ít 'tool' cần mạo từ 'an' trước nguyên âm /ɪ/ của 'indispensable'.

errorFixes.sentenceWithError: Many graduates aspire to work in European Union after completing their master's degree.

errorFixes.sentenceWithError: Government should invest more in vocational training for unemployed youth.

errorFixes.explanationVi: Chữ 'h' trong 'hour' là âm câm (/ˈaʊə/), nên phải dùng mạo từ 'an hour'.

errorFixes.sentenceWithError: Excessive screen exposure has a negative impact to children's sleep quality.
errorFixes.fullCorrectSentence: Excessive screen exposure has a negative impact on children's sleep quality.
errorFixes.explanationVi: Collocation chuẩn luôn là 'have an impact/effect ON something', không dùng 'to'.

errorFixes.sentenceWithError: In my opinion, parents are largely responsible of monitoring their children online.
errorFixes.fullCorrectSentence: In my opinion, parents are largely responsible for monitoring their children online.
errorFixes.explanationVi: Cấu trúc chuẩn là 'be responsible FOR + N/V-ing'.

errorFixes.sentenceWithError: The essay will discuss about the economic benefits of remote employment.
errorFixes.fullCorrectSentence: The essay will discuss the economic benefits of remote employment.
errorFixes.explanationVi: 'discuss' là ngoại động từ đi thẳng với tân ngữ, KHÔNG thêm giới từ 'about'.

errorFixes.sentenceWithError: Many rural clinics suffer a chronic shortage of qualified medical staff.
errorFixes.fullCorrectSentence: Many rural clinics suffer from a chronic shortage of qualified medical staff.
errorFixes.explanationVi: Cụm động từ chuẩn khi nói chịu đựng khó khăn/thiếu hụt là 'suffer FROM'.

errorFixes.sentenceWithError: High-speed rail offers an eco-friendly alternative than short-haul domestic flights.
errorFixes.fullCorrectSentence: High-speed rail offers an eco-friendly alternative to short-haul domestic flights.
errorFixes.explanationVi: 'alternative' luôn đi với giới từ 'to' ('an alternative to X').

errorFixes.sentenceWithError: Public libraries play a vital role in providing equal access for digital resources.
errorFixes.fullCorrectSentence: Public libraries play a vital role in providing equal access to digital resources.
errorFixes.explanationVi: Danh từ 'access' luôn đi với giới từ 'to' ('access to education/resources').

errorFixes.sentenceWithError: Despite of strict speed limits, road accidents remain common during wet weather.
errorFixes.fullCorrectSentence: Despite strict speed limits, road accidents remain common during wet weather.
errorFixes.explanationVi: 'Despite' KHÔNG bao giờ đi kèm 'of' (chỉ 'In spite of' mới có 'of').

errorFixes.sentenceWithError: Urban temperatures rose sharply between 1990 to 2020 across southern Europe.
errorFixes.fullCorrectSentence: Urban temperatures rose sharply between 1990 and 2020 across southern Europe.

errorFixes.sentenceWithError: Young workers often struggle to cope up with soaring metropolitan housing costs.
errorFixes.fullCorrectSentence: Young workers often struggle to cope with soaring metropolitan housing costs.
errorFixes.explanationVi: Cụm đúng là 'cope with' (đối phó với); không có từ 'up' ở giữa.

errorFixes.sentenceWithError: According to me, subsidising renewable power is the wisest long-term strategy.
errorFixes.fullCorrectSentence: In my view, subsidising renewable power is the wisest long-term strategy.
errorFixes.explanationVi: Trong tiếng Anh học thuật không dùng 'According to me'; dùng 'In my view,' hoặc 'From my perspective,'.

errorFixes.sentenceWithError: Although renewable energy is initially costly, but it saves money in the long run.
errorFixes.fullCorrectSentence: Although renewable energy is initially costly, it saves money in the long run.
errorFixes.explanationVi: Trong tiếng Anh không dùng đồng thời cả 'Although' lẫn 'but' trong cùng một câu.

errorFixes.sentenceWithError: Public transport is affordable, however, many residents still prefer private cars.

errorFixes.explanationVi: 'however' là trạng từ liên kết, không nối hai mệnh đề độc lập chỉ bằng dấu phẩy (lỗi comma splice); phải dùng dấu chấm phẩy ';' hoặc dấu chấm '.'.

errorFixes.sentenceWithError: Because of air pollution is worsening, several cities have introduced low-emission zones.
errorFixes.errorSpan: Because of air pollution is worsening,

errorFixes.fullCorrectSentence: Because air pollution is worsening, several cities have introduced low-emission zones.
errorFixes.explanationVi: 'Because of' chỉ đi với cụm danh từ; trước một mệnh đề có chủ-vị phải dùng 'Because'.

errorFixes.sentenceWithError: While working from home reduces commuting time. It can weaken team cohesion.
errorFixes.fullCorrectSentence: While working from home reduces commuting time, it can weaken team cohesion.
errorFixes.explanationVi: 'While + mệnh đề' là mệnh đề phụ, không được tách thành câu độc lập (lỗi sentence fragment).

errorFixes.sentenceWithError: Because traffic congestion wastes hours daily, so employers should allow flexible start times.
errorFixes.fullCorrectSentence: Because traffic congestion wastes hours daily, employers should allow flexible start times.
errorFixes.explanationVi: Không dùng đồng thời cả 'Because' và 'so' trong cùng một câu.

errorFixes.sentenceWithError: Even though the high tuition fees, demand for overseas degrees continues to climb.
errorFixes.errorSpan: Even though the high tuition fees,
distractors: Even if the high tuition fees,
errorFixes.fullCorrectSentence: Despite the high tuition fees, demand for overseas degrees continues to climb.
errorFixes.explanationVi: 'Even though' cần một mệnh đề đầy đủ; trước cụm danh từ 'the high tuition fees' phải dùng 'Despite'.

errorFixes.sentenceWithError: The reason why obesity is rising is because processed food is cheap and convenient.
errorFixes.fullCorrectSentence: The reason why obesity is rising is that processed food is cheap and convenient.
errorFixes.explanationVi: Tránh lặp nghĩa 'The reason ... is because'; cấu trúc chuẩn là 'The reason ... is that...'.

errorFixes.sentenceWithError: Not only the new metro line eases congestion, but it also lowers carbon emissions.
errorFixes.errorSpan: Not only the new metro line eases

distractors: Not only did the new metro line eases
