naturalPhrases.band6Equivalent: think about good and bad points
naturalPhrases.questionPrompt: How do you make major life decisions such as changing careers?
naturalPhrases.sampleSentence: Before making any big leap, I sit down with a notebook and carefully weigh up the pros and cons.
naturalPhrases.explanationVi: Cụm động từ cực mượt cho câu hỏi ra quyết định ở Part 2 và Part 3.

part23Frameworks.question: Describe an inspiring teacher or mentor who influenced your life.

steps.stepLabel: 1. Giới thiệu & bối cảnh quen biết
steps.chunk: I'd like to talk about Mr. Minh, my high-school physics teacher whom I met in grade eleven.
steps.meaningVi: Nêu rõ người đó là ai và quen trong hoàn cảnh nào.

steps.stepLabel: 2. Tính cách nổi bật + ví dụ
steps.chunk: What made him stand out was how down-to-earth and patient he was—he always turned dry formulas into lively classroom experiments.
steps.meaningVi: Dùng tính từ đa dạng (down-to-earth, patient) kèm hành động minh chứng.

steps.chunk: One memory that still sticks with me is when he stayed after school to help me prepare for a regional science competition.
steps.meaningVi: Kể một khoảnh khắc cụ thể để bài nói sống động và đủ 2 phút.

steps.chunk: All in all, he sparked my curiosity and taught me never to fear complex challenges.
steps.meaningVi: Chốt lại ảnh hưởng lâu dài của người đó với bản thân.

part23Frameworks.fullSampleAnswer: I'd like to talk about Mr. Minh, my high-school physics teacher whom I met in grade eleven. What made him stand out was how down-to-earth and patient he was—he always turned dry formulas into lively classroom experiments. One memory that still sticks with me is when he stayed after school to help me prepare for a regional science competition, even though I was a bit nervous at first. All in all, he sparked my curiosity and taught me never to fear complex challenges.
part23Frameworks.tipsVi: Với cue card Describe a person (theo khung Anki): nêu họ là ai → tính cách + 1 hành động cụ thể → 1 kỷ niệm đáng nhớ → tác động đến bạn. Dùng các tính từ tính cách Band 8.0 như down-to-earth, supportive, inspiring.

part23Frameworks.question: Describe a peaceful natural place you like to visit.

steps.chunk: I'm going to talk about Tuyen Lam Lake, a tranquil pine-ringed reservoir just outside Da Lat.
steps.meaningVi: Nêu tên địa điểm và vị trí địa lý cụ thể.

steps.chunk: Early in the morning, a cool mist drifts over the emerald water and the air smells faintly of damp pine needles.
steps.meaningVi: Dùng miêu tả thị giác, khứu giác và âm thanh để ăn điểm Lexical Resource.

steps.chunk: Whenever I visit with friends, we rent a kayak or sip hot ginger coffee on a wooden pier overlooking the hills.
steps.meaningVi: Kể những hoạt động cụ thể bạn làm ở đó.

steps.stepLabel: 4. Cảm xúc & lý do muốn quay lại
steps.chunk: It's my go-to sanctuary to escape the hustle and bustle and recharge my batteries.
steps.meaningVi: Kết lại bằng cảm nhận cá nhân và lý do nơi đó đặc biệt.

part23Frameworks.fullSampleAnswer: I'm going to talk about Tuyen Lam Lake, a tranquil pine-ringed reservoir just outside Da Lat. Early in the morning, a cool mist drifts over the emerald water and the air smells faintly of damp pine needles. Whenever I visit with friends, we rent a kayak or sip hot ginger coffee on a wooden pier overlooking the hills. It's my go-to sanctuary to escape the hustle and bustle and recharge my batteries, and I'd gladly go back every winter.
part23Frameworks.tipsVi: Với cue card Describe a place (khung Anki): tên & vị trí → lần đầu đến → mô tả bằng giác quan (nhìn, nghe, mùi) → hoạt động → cảm xúc và mong muốn quay lại.

part23Frameworks.question: Describe a meaningful item you own that you would never give away.

steps.chunk: One prized possession I'd never part with is a mechanical film camera my grandfather passed down to me on my eighteenth birthday.
steps.meaningVi: Giới thiệu đồ vật, có từ khi nào và ai tặng.

steps.chunk: It has a brushed silver body, tactile metal dials, and a classic leather strap that still looks remarkably sturdy.
steps.meaningVi: Miêu tả hình dáng, chất liệu bằng tính từ cụ thể.

steps.chunk: Because every roll only holds thirty-six frames, taking it on trips forces me to slow down and compose each shot carefully.
steps.meaningVi: Biến đồ vật thành thói quen hoặc câu chuyện gắn với cuộc sống.

steps.chunk: Beyond its craftsmanship, it keeps my grandfather's creative spirit alive, which makes it irreplaceable to me.
steps.meaningVi: Giải thích vì sao món đồ quan trọng vượt lên giá trị vật chất.

part23Frameworks.fullSampleAnswer: One prized possession I'd never part with is a mechanical film camera my grandfather passed down to me on my eighteenth birthday. It has a brushed silver body, tactile metal dials, and a classic leather strap that still looks remarkably sturdy. Because every roll only holds thirty-six frames, taking it on trips forces me to slow down and compose each shot carefully. Beyond its craftsmanship, it keeps my grandfather's creative spirit alive, which makes it irreplaceable to me.
part23Frameworks.tipsVi: Theo khung Anki 'Describe an object': biến đồ vật thành một câu chuyện nhỏ (ai tặng, kỷ niệm dùng nó) sẽ dễ nói đủ 2 phút hơn nhiều so với chỉ tả ngoại hình.

part23Frameworks.question: Describe a challenging event or competition you took part in.

steps.stepLabel: 1. Bối cảnh thời gian & địa điểm
steps.chunk: Last November, I signed up for my first half-marathon along the coastal boulevard in Da Nang.
steps.meaningVi: Mở đầu rõ khi nào, ở đâu, sự kiện gì.

steps.chunk: I had spent three months training at dawn, gradually building up my stamina despite the humid mornings.
steps.meaningVi: Dùng thì quá khứ hoàn thành (had spent) để tăng điểm Grammar.

steps.stepLabel: 3. Diễn biến & tình huống bất ngờ
steps.chunk: Around kilometre fifteen, a sudden tropical downpour soaked everyone, and my legs felt like lead—yet the cheering spectators kept me going.
steps.meaningVi: Tạo cao trào bất ngờ để câu chuyện cuốn hút.

steps.chunk: Crossing that finish line left me over the moon and proved how much grit consistent habits can build.
steps.meaningVi: Kết bằng cảm xúc vỡ òa và bài học rút ra.

part23Frameworks.fullSampleAnswer: Last November, I signed up for my first half-marathon along the coastal boulevard in Da Nang. I had spent three months training at dawn, gradually building up my stamina despite the humid mornings. Around kilometre fifteen, a sudden tropical downpour soaked everyone, and my legs felt like lead—yet the cheering spectators kept me going. Crossing that finish line left me over the moon and proved how much grit consistent habits can build.
part23Frameworks.tipsVi: Với cue card Describe an event (khung Anki): phối hợp linh hoạt 3 thì quá khứ (Past Simple, Past Continuous, Past Perfect) để chứng tỏ Grammatical Range Band 8.0.

part23Frameworks.question: Describe a practical skill you learned outside of school.

steps.stepLabel: 1. Kỹ năng gì & động lực học
steps.chunk: A hands-on skill I picked up outside the classroom is cooking authentic Vietnamese pho from scratch.
steps.meaningVi: Nêu kỹ năng và lý do bắt đầu học.

steps.chunk: I was a bit nervous at first because balancing charred ginger, star anise, and bone broth takes real patience.
steps.meaningVi: Kể thử thách ban đầu giúp câu chuyện chân thực.

steps.chunk: After four or five weekend attempts under my mother's guidance, I finally started to get the hang of it.
steps.meaningVi: Dùng idiom 'get the hang of it' để diễn tả sự tiến bộ.

steps.chunk: Nowadays, cooking a big pot for friends is my favourite way to unwind and share a taste of home.
steps.meaningVi: Liên hệ với hiện tại nếu còn dư thời gian trước mốc 2 phút.

part23Frameworks.fullSampleAnswer: A hands-on skill I picked up outside the classroom is cooking authentic Vietnamese pho from scratch. I was a bit nervous at first because balancing charred ginger, star anise, and bone broth takes real patience. After four or five weekend attempts under my mother's guidance, I finally started to get the hang of it. Nowadays, cooking a big pot for friends is my favourite way to unwind and share a taste of home.
part23Frameworks.tipsVi: Nếu nói gần hết ý mà chưa đủ 2 phút, hãy mở rộng bằng cách so sánh với hiện tại hoặc nói về món tiếp theo bạn muốn học.

part23Frameworks.question: Describe a digital app or piece of software you find indispensable.

steps.chunk: An app I rely on virtually every single day is Anki, a spaced-repetition flashcard tool I use for IELTS preparation.
steps.meaningVi: Giới thiệu rõ ứng dụng và mục đích sử dụng.

steps.chunk: What sets it apart is its scheduling algorithm, which surfaces tricky vocabulary right before I'm about to forget it.
steps.meaningVi: Giải thích tính năng cốt lõi bằng từ vựng chuẩn xác.

steps.stepLabel: 3. Cách tích hợp vào thói quen
steps.chunk: I usually review fifty cards during my morning bus ride instead of mindlessly scrolling social media.
steps.meaningVi: Nêu thói quen thực tế để bài nói tự nhiên.

steps.chunk: Over six months, it has transformed my retention and made exam preparation far less overwhelming.
steps.meaningVi: Chốt lại tác động tích cực rõ rệt.

part23Frameworks.fullSampleAnswer: An app I rely on virtually every single day is Anki, a spaced-repetition flashcard tool I use for IELTS preparation. What sets it apart is its scheduling algorithm, which surfaces tricky vocabulary right before I'm about to forget it. I usually review fifty cards during my morning bus ride instead of mindlessly scrolling social media. Over six months, it has transformed my retention and made exam preparation far less overwhelming.
part23Frameworks.tipsVi: Tránh liệt kê tính năng khô khan như quảng cáo; luôn gắn phần mềm với thói quen thực tế hằng ngày của bạn.

part23Frameworks.question: Describe a memorable journey that did not go completely as planned.

steps.stepLabel: 1. Chuyến đi & kế hoạch ban đầu
steps.chunk: Two summers ago, I booked an overnight sleeper train to Hue to explore the imperial citadel.
steps.meaningVi: Nêu rõ điểm đến, thời gian và kế hoạch.

steps.chunk: Out of the blue, heavy landslides blocked the railway track, stranding our train near a tiny coastal village for five hours.
steps.meaningVi: Dùng 'out of the blue' mở nút thắt câu chuyện.

steps.chunk: Rather than complaining, passengers shared snacks and local vendors brought baskets of hot steamed buns straight to the windows.
steps.meaningVi: Tập trung vào phản ứng và chi tiết đời thường giàu hình ảnh.

steps.chunk: Even though we arrived late, that unexpected detour left a lasting impression on me because of everyone's warmth.
steps.meaningVi: Chốt bài bằng cụm 'left a lasting impression on me'.

part23Frameworks.fullSampleAnswer: Two summers ago, I booked an overnight sleeper train to Hue to explore the imperial citadel. Out of the blue, heavy landslides blocked the railway track, stranding our train near a tiny coastal village for five hours. Rather than complaining, passengers shared snacks and local vendors brought baskets of hot steamed buns straight to the windows. Even though we arrived late, that unexpected detour left a lasting impression on me because of everyone's warmth.
part23Frameworks.tipsVi: Không cần có trải nghiệm y hệt ngoài đời (như thẻ Anki nhắc): bạn có thể ghép chi tiết hợp lý để chọn câu chuyện giàu từ vựng nhất.

part23Frameworks.question: Describe a book or documentary that changed how you view a topic.

steps.stepLabel: 1. Tên tác phẩm & cách biết đến
steps.chunk: A documentary that completely shifted my perspective is 'Our Planet', which I watched on a rainy weekend last year.
steps.meaningVi: Nêu tên tác phẩm và hoàn cảnh tiếp xúc.

steps.chunk: It pairs breathtaking wildlife cinematography with sobering data on how rapidly habitats are shrinking across every continent.
steps.meaningVi: Tóm tắt ngắn gọn nội dung bằng collocation học thuật.

steps.chunk: One sequence showing polar bears navigating thinning sea ice hit me hard and made climate change feel urgent rather than abstract.
steps.meaningVi: Chọn một cảnh cụ thể thay vì kể lan man cả bộ phim.

steps.chunk: Since watching it, I've cut down on single-use plastics and started paying closer attention to where my food comes from.
steps.meaningVi: Nêu thay đổi hành vi cụ thể sau khi xem.

part23Frameworks.fullSampleAnswer: A documentary that completely shifted my perspective is 'Our Planet', which I watched on a rainy weekend last year. It pairs breathtaking wildlife cinematography with sobering data on how rapidly habitats are shrinking across every continent. One sequence showing polar bears navigating thinning sea ice hit me hard and made climate change feel urgent rather than abstract. Since watching it, I've cut down on single-use plastics and started paying closer attention to where my food comes from.
part23Frameworks.tipsVi: Đừng tóm tắt cốt truyện quá dài; dành ít nhất một nửa thời gian nói về cảm xúc và sự thay đổi nhận thức của bạn.

part23Frameworks.question: Describe a successful group project you collaborated on.

steps.chunk: During my final year at university, I teamed up with three classmates to design a campus recycling campaign.
steps.meaningVi: Nêu rõ dự án, nhóm mấy người và vai trò của bạn.

steps.chunk: We hit the ground running by dividing tasks according to each person's strengths—I handled data surveys while my teammates managed posters and logistics.
steps.meaningVi: Dùng idiom 'hit the ground running' và nêu phân công cụ thể.

steps.chunk: Halfway through, we disagreed over bin placement, so we tested two layouts for a week and let actual usage figures settle the debate.
steps.meaningVi: Thêm một xung đột nhỏ và cách giải quyết thông minh.

steps.chunk: By the end of term, campus plastic sorting had jumped by forty percent, showing me how rewarding genuine teamwork can be.
steps.meaningVi: Chốt bằng kết quả đo được và bài học.

part23Frameworks.fullSampleAnswer: During my final year at university, I teamed up with three classmates to design a campus recycling campaign. We hit the ground running by dividing tasks according to each person's strengths—I handled data surveys while my teammates managed posters and logistics. Halfway through, we disagreed over bin placement, so we tested two layouts for a week and let actual usage figures settle the debate. By the end of term, campus plastic sorting had jumped by forty percent, showing me how rewarding genuine teamwork can be.
part23Frameworks.tipsVi: Giám khảo rất thích câu chuyện có xung đột nhỏ và cách xử lý thực tế vì nó tạo cơ hội dùng nhiều cấu trúc giải thích và tương phản.

part23Frameworks.question: Describe a healthy habit you adopted recently.

steps.stepLabel: 1. Thói quen gì & khi nào bắt đầu
steps.chunk: About six months ago, I made a conscious decision to take a brisk thirty-minute walk every morning before checking my phone.
steps.meaningVi: Nêu thói quen cụ thể và thời điểm bắt đầu.

steps.chunk: Previously, I used to wake up groggy and immediately dive into emails, which left me drained before noon.
steps.meaningVi: Đối chiếu thói quen cũ bằng 'used to'.

steps.chunk: To make the habit stick, I laid my running shoes beside the door and listened to English podcasts along the park loop.
steps.meaningVi: Nêu mẹo cụ thể giúp duy trì thói quen.

steps.chunk: Not only has my sleep improved dramatically, but my focus during afternoon study sessions is also noticeably sharper.
steps.meaningVi: Dùng cấu trúc 'Not only ... but also' trong văn nói cực ấn tượng.

part23Frameworks.fullSampleAnswer: About six months ago, I made a conscious decision to take a brisk thirty-minute walk every morning before checking my phone. Previously, I used to wake up groggy and immediately dive into emails, which left me drained before noon. To make the habit stick, I laid my running shoes beside the door and listened to English podcasts along the park loop. Not only has my sleep improved dramatically, but my focus during afternoon study sessions is also noticeably sharper.
part23Frameworks.tipsVi: Chủ đề sức khỏe rất dễ mở rộng sang Part 3; hãy chuẩn bị sẵn từ vựng như stamina, mental clarity, sedentary lifestyle.

part23Frameworks.question: Describe a traditional festival or celebration in your country.

steps.chunk: I'd love to describe Tet, our Lunar New Year celebration, which usually falls in late January or February.
steps.meaningVi: Giới thiệu ngắn gọn tên và thời gian diễn ra.

steps.chunk: In the week leading up to New Year's Eve, markets burst into colour with yellow apricot blossoms and families deep-clean their homes.
steps.meaningVi: Mô tả sinh động bằng hình ảnh và màu sắc.

steps.chunk: On the first morning, relatives gather for a feast of sticky rice cakes, exchange red lucky envelopes, and wish elders longevity.
steps.meaningVi: Dùng động từ cụ thể (gather, exchange, wish) thay vì liệt kê danh từ rời rạc.

steps.chunk: What makes Tet truly special is the rare pause it offers for busy family members to reconnect under one roof.
steps.meaningVi: Nhấn mạnh giá trị văn hóa cốt lõi.

part23Frameworks.fullSampleAnswer: I'd love to describe Tet, our Lunar New Year celebration, which usually falls in late January or February. In the week leading up to New Year's Eve, markets burst into colour with yellow apricot blossoms and families deep-clean their homes. On the first morning, relatives gather for a feast of sticky rice cakes, exchange red lucky envelopes, and wish elders longevity. What makes Tet truly special is the rare pause it offers for busy family members to reconnect under one roof.
part23Frameworks.tipsVi: Khi giải thích khái niệm văn hóa Việt (bánh chưng, lì xì), diễn giải ngắn bằng tiếng Anh dễ hiểu (sticky rice cakes, red lucky envelopes) để giám khảo nước ngoài nắm ngay.

part23Frameworks.question: Describe an interesting historic or modern building in your city.

steps.chunk: One landmark that always catches my eye is the Central Post Office in the heart of Ho Chi Minh City.
steps.meaningVi: Nêu tên công trình và vị trí trung tâm.

steps.stepLabel: 2. Kiến trúc bên ngoài & bên trong
steps.chunk: Built in the late nineteenth century, it blends yellow colonial arches with a soaring vaulted iron ceiling and hand-painted historic maps inside.
steps.meaningVi: Dùng thuật ngữ kiến trúc gợi hình (arches, vaulted ceiling).

steps.chunk: Unlike many heritage monuments that act merely as museums, it still operates as a bustling working post office where locals mail parcels.
steps.meaningVi: Nêu điểm độc đáo trong công năng hiện tại.

steps.chunk: Stepping inside feels like travelling back in time, reminding residents to treasure our architectural heritage.
steps.meaningVi: Chốt cảm xúc và giá trị lịch sử.

part23Frameworks.fullSampleAnswer: One landmark that always catches my eye is the Central Post Office in the heart of Ho Chi Minh City. Built in the late nineteenth century, it blends yellow colonial arches with a soaring vaulted iron ceiling and hand-painted historic maps inside. Unlike many heritage monuments that act merely as museums, it still operates as a bustling working post office where locals mail parcels. Stepping inside feels like travelling back in time, reminding residents to treasure our architectural heritage.
part23Frameworks.tipsVi: Chuẩn bị 4–5 từ vựng kiến trúc (vaulted ceiling, facade, landmark, heritage) giúp bạn xử lý gọn mọi đề về tòa nhà và thành phố.

part23Frameworks.question: Describe an important decision that took you a long time to make.

steps.chunk: A pivotal decision I wrestled with last year was whether to switch majors from accounting to data analytics.
steps.meaningVi: Nêu rõ hai lựa chọn cân nhắc.

steps.chunk: I was in two minds about it for months, carefully weighing up the pros and cons of starting fresh versus graduating on schedule.
steps.meaningVi: Lồng ghép mượt mà 'in two minds about' và 'weigh up the pros and cons'.

steps.stepLabel: 3. Yếu tố giúp chốt quyết định
steps.chunk: Talking to two alumni working in analytics finally convinced me that combining finance with coding would open far stronger prospects.
steps.meaningVi: Nêu bước ngoặt giúp đưa ra lựa chọn.

steps.chunk: Looking back, taking that leap was worth every extra hour of study because I genuinely look forward to my classes now.
steps.meaningVi: Đánh giá lại quyết định ở hiện tại.

part23Frameworks.fullSampleAnswer: A pivotal decision I wrestled with last year was whether to switch majors from accounting to data analytics. I was in two minds about it for months, carefully weighing up the pros and cons of starting fresh versus graduating on schedule. Talking to two alumni working in analytics finally convinced me that combining finance with coding would open far stronger prospects. Looking back, taking that leap was worth every extra hour of study because I genuinely look forward to my classes now.
part23Frameworks.tipsVi: Cấu trúc 'Looking back, ...' rất tự nhiên để đánh giá lại một quyết định trong quá khứ.

part23Frameworks.question: Describe a local environmental initiative you know about.

steps.chunk: I'd like to talk about a weekend canal clean-up group organised by young volunteers in my district.
steps.meaningVi: Giới thiệu sáng kiến cộng đồng gần gũi.

steps.chunk: Every Sunday morning, dozens of residents turn up with reusable gloves and mesh nets to clear floating plastic bottles from the waterway.
steps.meaningVi: Tả hành động cụ thể, chân thực.

steps.chunk: At first, litter kept returning after heavy rain, so the volunteers began visiting nearby markets to encourage vendors to switch to biodegradable bags.
steps.meaningVi: Cho thấy tư duy giải quyết tận gốc vấn đề.

steps.chunk: Seeing neighbours join in spontaneously proved to me that grassroots action can genuinely transform public attitudes.
steps.meaningVi: Kết bằng bài học về sức mạnh cộng đồng.

part23Frameworks.fullSampleAnswer: I'd like to talk about a weekend canal clean-up group organised by young volunteers in my district. Every Sunday morning, dozens of residents turn up with reusable gloves and mesh nets to clear floating plastic bottles from the waterway. At first, litter kept returning after heavy rain, so the volunteers began visiting nearby markets to encourage vendors to switch to biodegradable bags. Seeing neighbours join in spontaneously proved to me that grassroots action can genuinely transform public attitudes.
part23Frameworks.tipsVi: Từ vựng 'grassroots action' (hành động từ cộng đồng cơ sở) và 'biodegradable' rất ghi điểm cho chủ đề môi trường.

part23Frameworks.question: Describe a piece of good news that made you feel proud.

steps.chunk: The happiest news I received in recent years was an email announcing I had won a partial merit scholarship for university.
steps.meaningVi: Nêu trực tiếp tin vui ngay câu đầu.

steps.chunk: I had been burning the midnight oil for months polishing my essays and preparing for the panel interview.
steps.meaningVi: Nhấn mạnh nỗ lực trước đó để tạo sự tương phản cảm xúc.

steps.chunk: When I read the word 'congratulations' on my laptop screen, I was completely over the moon and immediately called my parents.
steps.meaningVi: Dùng idiom 'over the moon' đúng ngữ cảnh.

steps.chunk: Beyond easing my family's financial burden, it gave me the confidence to set even higher academic goals.
steps.meaningVi: Nêu ý nghĩa thiết thực và tinh thần.

part23Frameworks.fullSampleAnswer: The happiest news I received in recent years was an email announcing I had won a partial merit scholarship for university. I had been burning the midnight oil for months polishing my essays and preparing for the panel interview. When I read the word 'congratulations' on my laptop screen, I was completely over the moon and immediately called my parents. Beyond easing my family's financial burden, it gave me the confidence to set even higher academic goals.
part23Frameworks.tipsVi: Kết hợp quá khứ hoàn thành tiếp diễn ('had been burning') giúp thể hiện kiểm soát thì rất chắc tay.

part23Frameworks.question: Describe a close friend who has a very different personality from yours.

steps.chunk: My closest friend, Linh, is practically my polar opposite, yet we've been inseparable since freshman year.
steps.meaningVi: Dùng 'polar opposite' và 'inseparable' để mở bài ấn tượng.

steps.chunk: Whereas I tend to overthink and plan every itinerary to the minute, she is spontaneous, outgoing, and thrives on last-minute adventures.
steps.meaningVi: So sánh trực tiếp hai tính cách bằng 'Whereas'.

steps.chunk: Despite those contrasts, we're totally on the same wavelength when it comes to our core values and dry sense of humour.
steps.meaningVi: Dùng 'on the same wavelength' để giải thích sự hòa hợp.

steps.chunk: She gently nudges me out of my comfort zone, and I help keep her grounded—we really bring out the best in each other.
steps.meaningVi: Kết bằng collocation 'bring out the best in each other'.

part23Frameworks.fullSampleAnswer: My closest friend, Linh, is practically my polar opposite, yet we've been inseparable since freshman year. Whereas I tend to overthink and plan every itinerary to the minute, she is spontaneous, outgoing, and thrives on last-minute adventures. Despite those contrasts, we're totally on the same wavelength when it comes to our core values and dry sense of humour. She gently nudges me out of my comfort zone, and I help keep her grounded—we really bring out the best in each other.
part23Frameworks.tipsVi: Chuẩn bị sẵn cặp tính từ tính cách đối lập (spontaneous vs methodical, extroverted vs introverted) cho nhóm đề bạn bè.

part23Frameworks.question: Describe a time you received outstanding customer service.

steps.chunk: Last winter, my backpack zip snapped right before a weekend hike, so I rushed into a small neighbourhood repair shop.
steps.meaningVi: Dẫn vào tình huống cụ thể ngắn gọn.

steps.chunk: Even though it was nearly closing time, the shop owner smiled warmly, found a heavy-duty replacement zip, and stitched it on the spot.
steps.meaningVi: Kể hành động vượt mong đợi của nhân viên/chủ tiệm.

steps.chunk: On top of that, he reinforced the shoulder straps free of charge so the bag wouldn't fray on the trail.
steps.meaningVi: Dùng 'On top of that' để bổ sung chi tiết ghi điểm.

steps.stepLabel: 4. Cảm nhận & hành động sau đó
steps.chunk: His genuine pride in his craft was a breath of fresh air, and I've recommended his shop to every friend since.
steps.meaningVi: Chốt bằng tác động thực tế (giới thiệu cho bạn bè).

part23Frameworks.fullSampleAnswer: Last winter, my backpack zip snapped right before a weekend hike, so I rushed into a small neighbourhood repair shop. Even though it was nearly closing time, the shop owner smiled warmly, found a heavy-duty replacement zip, and stitched it on the spot. On top of that, he reinforced the shoulder straps free of charge so the bag wouldn't fray on the trail. His genuine pride in his craft was a breath of fresh air, and I've recommended his shop to every friend since.
part23Frameworks.tipsVi: Đề dịch vụ khách hàng dễ hay khi bạn chọn tình huống đời thường (tiệm sửa đồ, hiệu sách, quán cà phê) thay vì câu chuyện chung chung.

part23Frameworks.question: Describe a hobby you would like to try in the future.

steps.chunk: A creative hobby I've been itching to pick up is wheel-thrown pottery.
steps.meaningVi: Dùng 'be itching to pick up' (rất háo hức muốn học) cực tự nhiên.

steps.chunk: After spending eight hours a day staring at code on a monitor, shaping wet clay by hand sounds wonderfully grounding.
steps.meaningVi: Liên hệ lý do với công việc/học tập hiện tại.

steps.chunk: I've already bookmarked a beginner ceramics studio near my flat that runs Saturday morning workshops.
steps.meaningVi: Nêu kế hoạch thực tế thay vì nói suông.

steps.chunk: Even if my first few mugs turn out lopsided, I'd love to gift handmade tableware to my family one day.
steps.meaningVi: Kết bằng hình ảnh cụ thể, ấm áp.

part23Frameworks.fullSampleAnswer: A creative hobby I've been itching to pick up is wheel-thrown pottery. After spending eight hours a day staring at code on a monitor, shaping wet clay by hand sounds wonderfully grounding. I've already bookmarked a beginner ceramics studio near my flat that runs Saturday morning workshops. Even if my first few mugs turn out lopsided, I'd love to gift handmade tableware to my family one day.
part23Frameworks.tipsVi: Với đề về tương lai, kết hợp hiện tại hoàn thành ('I've already bookmarked...') và câu điều kiện ('Even if...') để đa dạng ngữ pháp.

part23Frameworks.question: Describe a scientific invention you think has greatly improved daily life.

steps.chunk: While smartphones get all the headlines, I'd argue that GPS navigation has quietly revolutionised everyday mobility.
steps.meaningVi: Mở bài bằng cú đối chiếu tinh tế.

steps.chunk: Back when I was a kid, drivers had to unfold giant paper maps and stop repeatedly to ask strangers for directions.
steps.meaningVi: Dùng khung so sánh quá khứ–hiện tại để mở rộng độ dài.

steps.chunk: Nowadays, live satellite routing not only saves commuters hours stuck in traffic, but also allows ambulances to reach emergencies far faster.
steps.meaningVi: Nêu cả lợi ích cá nhân lẫn lợi ích xã hội (xe cứu thương).

steps.chunk: Having said that, relying on it blindly can weaken our sense of direction—still, its overall convenience is second to none.
steps.meaningVi: Thêm một ý phản biện nhẹ bằng 'Having said that' để tăng chiều sâu.

part23Frameworks.fullSampleAnswer: While smartphones get all the headlines, I'd argue that GPS navigation has quietly revolutionised everyday mobility. Back when I was a kid, drivers had to unfold giant paper maps and stop repeatedly to ask strangers for directions. Nowadays, live satellite routing not only saves commuters hours stuck in traffic, but also allows ambulances to reach emergencies far faster. Having said that, relying on it blindly can weaken our sense of direction—still, its overall convenience is second to none.
part23Frameworks.tipsVi: Chọn một phát minh cụ thể (GPS, vắc-xin, tủ lạnh, năng lượng mặt trời) giúp bạn nói sâu hơn nhiều so với chọn 'the internet' quá rộng.

part23Frameworks.question: How have children's leisure activities changed compared to thirty years ago?

steps.chunk: Compared to three decades ago, children's free time has shifted dramatically from outdoor neighbourhood play to screen-based entertainment.
steps.meaningVi: Mở thẳng vào sự tương phản cốt lõi.

steps.chunk: The main reason is that rapid urbanisation has shrunk safe green spaces, while dual-income parents often feel safer keeping kids indoors.
steps.meaningVi: Giải thích nguyên nhân mang tầm xã hội, không chỉ cá nhân.

steps.chunk: Take my own street, for instance: children used to play hide-and-seek until dusk, whereas nowadays they mostly connect over online games.
steps.meaningVi: Dùng 'Take..., for instance' + 'used to ... whereas nowadays'.

steps.chunk: Having said that, the underlying desire to socialise with peers hasn't changed—it's simply moved into a digital arena.
steps.meaningVi: Chốt sâu sắc bằng điểm giống nhau xuyên thời gian.

part23Frameworks.fullSampleAnswer: Compared to three decades ago, children's free time has shifted dramatically from outdoor neighbourhood play to screen-based entertainment. The main reason is that rapid urbanisation has shrunk safe green spaces, while dual-income parents often feel safer keeping kids indoors. Take my own street, for instance: children used to play hide-and-seek until dusk, whereas nowadays they mostly connect over online games. Having said that, the underlying desire to socialise with peers hasn't changed—it's simply moved into a digital arena.
part23Frameworks.tipsVi: Theo khung Anki Part 3 So sánh: nêu điểm khác chính → giải thích nguyên nhân → ví dụ → điểm giống nhau hoặc hệ quả.

part23Frameworks.question: Why do so many young graduates choose to move to major megacities?

steps.chunk: Perhaps the primary driver is career opportunity: corporate headquarters, tech startups, and higher starting salaries are heavily concentrated in megacities.
steps.meaningVi: Đưa nguyên nhân quan trọng nhất lên trước.

steps.chunk: Another major factor is lifestyle and networking—big cities offer vibrant cultural scenes, specialist universities, and easier access to mentors.
steps.meaningVi: Bổ sung góc nhìn thứ hai bằng 'Another major factor is...'.

steps.chunk: In Vietnam, for example, graduates from coastal provinces routinely flock to Ho Chi Minh City or Hanoi right after finishing college.
steps.meaningVi: Ví dụ thực tế tại Việt Nam luôn tự nhiên và thuyết phục.

steps.chunk: Of course, steep rents make it tough to make ends meet initially, yet most young adults view that trade-off as an investment in their future.
steps.meaningVi: Khép lại bằng góc nhìn hai chiều chín chắn.

part23Frameworks.fullSampleAnswer: Perhaps the primary driver is career opportunity: corporate headquarters, tech startups, and higher starting salaries are heavily concentrated in megacities. Another major factor is lifestyle and networking—big cities offer vibrant cultural scenes, specialist universities, and easier access to mentors. In Vietnam, for example, graduates from coastal provinces routinely flock to Ho Chi Minh City or Hanoi right after finishing college. Of course, steep rents make it tough to make ends meet initially, yet most young adults view that trade-off as an investment in their future.
part23Frameworks.tipsVi: Theo khung Anki Part 3 Nguyên nhân: đưa 2 nguyên nhân rõ ràng kèm giải thích/ví dụ và phân cấp nguyên nhân nào mạnh hơn.

part23Frameworks.question: How can cities encourage more residents to switch from private cars to public transport?

steps.chunk: First and foremost, municipal governments need to make public transit genuinely reliable and frequent so commuters aren't left waiting in the heat.
steps.meaningVi: Chỉ rõ chủ thể thực hiện (municipal governments) và giải pháp cốt lõi.

steps.stepLabel: 2. Giải pháp tài chính (câu điều kiện)
steps.chunk: If cities introduced affordable monthly pass caps while raising downtown parking fees, far more drivers would reconsider taking their cars.
steps.meaningVi: Dùng câu điều kiện loại 2 như thẻ Anki khuyến nghị cho câu hỏi giải pháp.

steps.chunk: On top of that, shaded walkways and safe bicycle parking around stations solve the 'last-mile' gap.
steps.meaningVi: Thêm giải pháp thực tế chứng tỏ tư duy quy hoạch.

steps.chunk: Admittedly, building metro networks takes years and massive budgets, so upgrading rapid bus lanes is a smarter short-term step.
steps.meaningVi: Nêu hạn chế và giải pháp ngắn hạn để thể hiện tư duy thực tế.

part23Frameworks.fullSampleAnswer: First and foremost, municipal governments need to make public transit genuinely reliable and frequent so commuters aren't left waiting in the heat. If cities introduced affordable monthly pass caps while raising downtown parking fees, far more drivers would reconsider taking their cars. On top of that, shaded walkways and safe bicycle parking around stations solve the 'last-mile' gap. Admittedly, building metro networks takes years and massive budgets, so upgrading rapid bus lanes is a smarter short-term step.
part23Frameworks.tipsVi: Theo khung Anki Part 3 Giải pháp: đề xuất 1–2 giải pháp → ai thực hiện → vì sao hiệu quả (dùng If loại 2) → hạn chế có thể có.

part23Frameworks.question: How do you think artificial intelligence will change workplaces over the next twenty years?

steps.chunk: I'd imagine that AI will reshape almost every white-collar profession, though it's more likely to transform tasks than erase entire careers overnight.
steps.meaningVi: Dùng ngôn ngữ rào đón 'I'd imagine that...' và 'more likely to...'.

steps.stepLabel: 2. Lý do từ xu hướng hiện nay
steps.chunk: Already, software can draft standard contracts and analyse spreadsheets in seconds, freeing staff to focus on strategy and client empathy.
steps.meaningVi: Gắn dự đoán với bằng chứng xu hướng hiện tại.

steps.chunk: In healthcare, for instance, diagnostic algorithms will probably flag early scans while human doctors remain essential for explaining treatment options.
steps.meaningVi: Ví dụ cụ thể làm rõ ranh giới giữa máy và người.

steps.chunk: In the long run, continuous reskilling will become compulsory so entry-level workers aren't left behind.
steps.meaningVi: Chốt bằng cụm 'In the long run' nêu tác động xã hội.

part23Frameworks.fullSampleAnswer: I'd imagine that AI will reshape almost every white-collar profession, though it's more likely to transform tasks than erase entire careers overnight. Already, software can draft standard contracts and analyse spreadsheets in seconds, freeing staff to focus on strategy and client empathy. In healthcare, for instance, diagnostic algorithms will probably flag early scans while human doctors remain essential for explaining treatment options. In the long run, continuous reskilling will become compulsory so entry-level workers aren't left behind.
part23Frameworks.tipsVi: Theo khung Anki Part 3 Dự đoán tương lai: dự đoán có rào đón → lý do từ hiện tại → ví dụ → tác động dài hạn.

part23Frameworks.question: Overall, do you think social media has been a positive or negative development for society?

steps.chunk: Honestly, I'm in two minds about it because social media is a classic double-edged sword.
steps.meaningVi: Tránh cực đoan một chiều; mở bằng góc nhìn cân bằng.

steps.chunk: On the plus side, it empowers small local businesses to reach global customers at almost zero marketing cost and helps distant families stay close.
steps.meaningVi: Phân tích lợi ích thiết thực kèm chi tiết.

steps.chunk: Having said that, engagement-driven algorithms frequently amplify misinformation and fuel unhealthy social comparison among teenagers.
steps.meaningVi: Chuyển ý mượt bằng 'Having said that'.

steps.stepLabel: 4. Chốt quan điểm nghiêng về một bên
steps.chunk: On balance, I'd say it's net positive only if societies invest seriously in digital literacy and stronger platform accountability.
steps.meaningVi: Kết luận có điều kiện cực kỳ thuyết phục.

part23Frameworks.fullSampleAnswer: Honestly, I'm in two minds about it because social media is a classic double-edged sword. On the plus side, it empowers small local businesses to reach global customers at almost zero marketing cost and helps distant families stay close. Having said that, engagement-driven algorithms frequently amplify misinformation and fuel unhealthy social comparison among teenagers. On balance, I'd say it's net positive only if societies invest seriously in digital literacy and stronger platform accountability.
part23Frameworks.tipsVi: Theo khung Anki Part 3 Đánh giá (Good or bad): thừa nhận hai mặt → nghiêng về một bên hoặc nêu điều kiện → ví dụ.

part23Frameworks.question: Should schools rely more on continuous coursework than on high-stakes final exams?

steps.chunk: As far as I'm concerned, a blended assessment system works far better than betting a student's entire future on a single exam day.
steps.meaningVi: Đưa lập trường cân bằng nhưng rõ nét.

steps.chunk: Continuous projects mirror real workplace collaboration, research skills, and time management, whereas timed exams often reward rote memorisation.
steps.meaningVi: So sánh bản chất hai hình thức đánh giá.

steps.chunk: Admittedly, coursework raises valid concerns about plagiarism—especially with generative AI tools readily available.
steps.meaningVi: Thừa nhận phản biện thực tế hiện đại (AI/đạo văn).

steps.chunk: That's why combining in-class oral defences with supervised exams offers the fairest measure of true understanding.
steps.meaningVi: Đưa ra giải pháp tổng hợp thông minh.

part23Frameworks.fullSampleAnswer: As far as I'm concerned, a blended assessment system works far better than betting a student's entire future on a single exam day. Continuous projects mirror real workplace collaboration, research skills, and time management, whereas timed exams often reward rote memorisation. Admittedly, coursework raises valid concerns about plagiarism—especially with generative AI tools readily available. That's why combining in-class oral defences with supervised exams offers the fairest measure of true understanding.
part23Frameworks.tipsVi: Part 3 đòi hỏi nói về hệ thống xã hội nói chung; tránh chỉ kể chuyện điểm thi của bản thân.

part23Frameworks.question: Who bears greater responsibility for public health: individuals or governments?

steps.stepLabel: 1. Rào đón & chia sẻ trách nhiệm
steps.chunk: I'd say it's a shared responsibility, because personal choices don't happen in a vacuum.
steps.meaningVi: Cụm ẩn dụ 'don't happen in a vacuum' rất học thuật và tự nhiên.

steps.chunk: Naturally, individuals have to decide what they cook, how often they exercise, and whether they get enough sleep.
steps.meaningVi: Nêu rõ phạm vi trách nhiệm cá nhân.

steps.chunk: Yet governments shape the surrounding environment—by funding neighbourhood parks, labelling nutritional content clearly, and regulating sugary drinks.
steps.meaningVi: Giải thích vì sao môi trường chính sách quyết định hành vi.

steps.chunk: When healthy options are affordable and convenient, people find it far easier to make sensible daily choices.
steps.meaningVi: Kết câu mạch lạc bằng mệnh đề điều kiện.

part23Frameworks.fullSampleAnswer: I'd say it's a shared responsibility, because personal choices don't happen in a vacuum. Naturally, individuals have to decide what they cook, how often they exercise, and whether they get enough sleep. Yet governments shape the surrounding environment—by funding neighbourhood parks, labelling nutritional content clearly, and regulating sugary drinks. When healthy options are affordable and convenient, people find it far easier to make sensible daily choices.
part23Frameworks.tipsVi: Với các câu hỏi 'A hay B chịu trách nhiệm hơn?', cấu trúc 'Shared responsibility + phân định vai trò từng bên' luôn đạt điểm cao về tư duy.

part23Frameworks.question: Is remote working likely to become permanent across most industries?

steps.chunk: It depends heavily on the sector, really, rather than being a one-size-fits-all trend.
steps.meaningVi: Dùng 'It depends on' và 'one-size-fits-all' để mở ý thông minh.

steps.chunk: In software engineering, consulting, and design, hybrid schedules are quite likely to stick because companies save on office rent and attract wider talent.
steps.meaningVi: Phân tích nhánh 1 kèm lợi ích kinh tế.

steps.stepLabel: 3. Ngành không thể làm từ xa
steps.chunk: By contrast, hospitals, hospitality, and manufacturing obviously require physical presence on site.
steps.meaningVi: Phân tích nhánh 2 tạo sự đối lập rõ ràng.

steps.stepLabel: 4. Dự đoán mô hình phổ biến
steps.chunk: So in the long run, I'd imagine a three-day office, two-day home hybrid model will become the norm for knowledge workers.
steps.meaningVi: Chốt bằng dự đoán thực tế.

part23Frameworks.fullSampleAnswer: It depends heavily on the sector, really, rather than being a one-size-fits-all trend. In software engineering, consulting, and design, hybrid schedules are quite likely to stick because companies save on office rent and attract wider talent. By contrast, hospitals, hospitality, and manufacturing obviously require physical presence on site. So in the long run, I'd imagine a three-day office, two-day home hybrid model will become the norm for knowledge workers.
part23Frameworks.tipsVi: Chia nhóm đối tượng (knowledge workers vs frontline workers) là chiến thuật cực mạnh để trả lời Part 3 sâu và dài 4–6 câu.

part23Frameworks.question: Does globalisation threaten local cultural traditions?

steps.chunk: To some extent, yes—especially when global streaming platforms and fast-food chains make city high streets look virtually identical.
steps.meaningVi: Dùng 'To some extent' mở đầu hợp lý.

steps.chunk: Younger generations sometimes speak fewer regional dialects or neglect traditional crafts because they seem less lucrative.
steps.meaningVi: Nêu ví dụ cụ thể về ngôn ngữ địa phương và nghề thủ công.

steps.chunk: Having said that, globalisation has also given local artisans and indie musicians an international stage they never had before.
steps.meaningVi: Đưa phản biện tích cực sắc bén.

steps.chunk: So rather than erasing heritage automatically, it pushes communities to reinvent traditions creatively for modern audiences.
steps.meaningVi: Chốt ý đầy tính xây dựng.

part23Frameworks.fullSampleAnswer: To some extent, yes—especially when global streaming platforms and fast-food chains make city high streets look virtually identical. Younger generations sometimes speak fewer regional dialects or neglect traditional crafts because they seem less lucrative. Having said that, globalisation has also given local artisans and indie musicians an international stage they never had before. So rather than erasing heritage automatically, it pushes communities to reinvent traditions creatively for modern audiences.
part23Frameworks.tipsVi: Cặp lập luận 'đồng nhất hóa vs sân chơi toàn cầu cho nghệ nhân địa phương' giúp bài nói nổi bật hơn câu trả lời khuôn mẫu.

part23Frameworks.question: How can popular tourist destinations balance economic growth with environmental protection?

steps.chunk: That's a tricky balance, because local livelihoods often depend on visitor spending while fragile ecosystems can't handle overcrowding.
steps.meaningVi: Mở bài trực diện vào mâu thuẫn trung tâm.

steps.stepLabel: 2. Giải pháp điều tiết số lượng
steps.chunk: One practical measure is introducing daily visitor caps and timed entry tickets at heritage sites and coral reefs.
steps.meaningVi: Nêu giải pháp cụ thể (visitor caps, timed tickets).

steps.chunk: Another smart approach is dedicating a small eco-tax on hotel stays directly toward waste management and trail conservation.
steps.meaningVi: Nêu cơ chế tài chính bền vững (eco-tax).

steps.chunk: If destinations prioritise quality over sheer volume, they protect the very natural beauty that attracts travellers in the first place.
steps.meaningVi: Chốt bằng câu điều kiện sắc sảo.

part23Frameworks.fullSampleAnswer: That's a tricky balance, because local livelihoods often depend on visitor spending while fragile ecosystems can't handle overcrowding. One practical measure is introducing daily visitor caps and timed entry tickets at heritage sites and coral reefs. Another smart approach is dedicating a small eco-tax on hotel stays directly toward waste management and trail conservation. If destinations prioritise quality over sheer volume, they protect the very natural beauty that attracts travellers in the first place.
part23Frameworks.tipsVi: Phân biệt 'mass tourism' (du lịch đại trà) và 'sustainable/low-impact tourism' giúp nâng điểm Lexical Resource rõ rệt.

part23Frameworks.question: Why do many people find it harder to trust news sources today than in the past?

steps.chunk: The main reason is that social media rewards outrage and speed over careful fact-checking.
steps.meaningVi: Chỉ đúng cơ chế kinh tế chú ý (attention economy).

steps.chunk: In the past, print newspapers and public broadcasters had strict editorial layers, whereas nowadays anyone can publish polished misinformation in seconds.
steps.meaningVi: So sánh nhanh quá khứ và hiện tại.

steps.chunk: On top of that, deepfake videos and AI-generated articles have made it far trickier for ordinary readers to tell fact from fabrication.
steps.meaningVi: Cập nhật góc nhìn công nghệ hiện đại (deepfake).

steps.chunk: Consequently, healthy scepticism is useful, though total cynicism can unfortunately make citizens disengage from civic life altogether.
steps.meaningVi: Chốt bằng cặp từ sắc bén: 'healthy scepticism' vs 'total cynicism'.

part23Frameworks.fullSampleAnswer: The main reason is that social media rewards outrage and speed over careful fact-checking. In the past, print newspapers and public broadcasters had strict editorial layers, whereas nowadays anyone can publish polished misinformation in seconds. On top of that, deepfake videos and AI-generated articles have made it far trickier for ordinary readers to tell fact from fabrication. Consequently, healthy scepticism is useful, though total cynicism can unfortunately make citizens disengage from civic life altogether.
part23Frameworks.tipsVi: Phân biệt hai sắc thái gần nhau (scepticism vs cynicism) là kỹ thuật nói chuẩn Band 8.5.

part23Frameworks.question: What challenges does an ageing population create for modern societies?

steps.chunk: Most noticeably, a shrinking ratio of working-age taxpayers places an immense strain on state pension funds and public healthcare.
steps.meaningVi: Nêu hệ quả vĩ mô lớn nhất đầu tiên.

steps.stepLabel: 2. Thiếu hụt nhân lực chăm sóc
steps.chunk: Another pressing challenge is a shortage of trained caregivers and geriatric nurses to support elderly residents with chronic conditions.
steps.meaningVi: Mở rộng sang khía cạnh y tế & nhân lực.

steps.chunk: Take Japan, for instance, where rural towns have had to experiment with assistive robotics and later retirement ages.
steps.meaningVi: Dẫn chứng quốc gia điển hình (Nhật Bản).

steps.chunk: Having said that, healthy retirees also bring decades of mentoring experience if workplaces offer flexible part-time roles.
steps.meaningVi: Kết bằng góc nhìn tích cực, tránh bi quan một chiều.

part23Frameworks.fullSampleAnswer: Most noticeably, a shrinking ratio of working-age taxpayers places an immense strain on state pension funds and public healthcare. Another pressing challenge is a shortage of trained caregivers and geriatric nurses to support elderly residents with chronic conditions. Take Japan, for instance, where rural towns have had to experiment with assistive robotics and later retirement ages. Having said that, healthy retirees also bring decades of mentoring experience if workplaces offer flexible part-time roles.
part23Frameworks.tipsVi: Chuẩn bị sẵn từ vựng chủ đề dân số già: ageing demographic, pension burden, geriatric care, retirement age.

part23Frameworks.question: Do you think governments are justified in spending billions on space exploration?

steps.stepLabel: 1. Thừa nhận quan điểm phản đối
steps.chunk: Admittedly, it's easy to see why critics question huge space budgets when poverty and climate adaptation urgently need funding on Earth.
steps.meaningVi: Mở bằng nhượng bộ đồng cảm với góc nhìn phản biện.

steps.stepLabel: 2. Lập luận ủng hộ (ứng dụng đời sống)
steps.chunk: Nevertheless, space research generates remarkable spin-off technologies—from weather satellites that track typhoons to water filtration and medical imaging.
steps.meaningVi: Chứng minh lợi ích trực tiếp quay ngược về Trái Đất.

steps.chunk: On top of that, ambitious scientific missions inspire generations of students to pursue engineering and physics.
steps.meaningVi: Thêm góc độ giáo dục & nguồn nhân lực STEM.

steps.chunk: So provided that space agencies collaborate internationally to share costs, I think that investment pays off handsomely in the long run.
steps.meaningVi: Kết có điều kiện ('provided that') cực mượt.

part23Frameworks.fullSampleAnswer: Admittedly, it's easy to see why critics question huge space budgets when poverty and climate adaptation urgently need funding on Earth. Nevertheless, space research generates remarkable spin-off technologies—from weather satellites that track typhoons to water filtration and medical imaging. On top of that, ambitious scientific missions inspire generations of students to pursue engineering and physics. So provided that space agencies collaborate internationally to share costs, I think that investment pays off handsomely in the long run.
part23Frameworks.tipsVi: Từ 'spin-off technologies' (công nghệ phái sinh ứng dụng vào đời sống) là từ khóa vàng cho đề vũ trụ/nghiên cứu cơ bản.

part23Frameworks.question: Why do many consumers keep buying cheap fast fashion even when they know it harms the planet?

steps.chunk: First and foremost, affordability plays a huge role: for students or families on tight budgets, sustainable brands can cost an arm and a leg.
steps.meaningVi: Giải thích thực tế kinh tế thay vì phán xét người tiêu dùng.

steps.chunk: Another driver is relentless trend cycles on TikTok and Instagram, which create constant social pressure to appear in new outfits.
steps.meaningVi: Phân tích tác động truyền thông xã hội.

steps.chunk: What I mean is, people often care about the environment in principle, yet convenience wins at the checkout screen.
steps.meaningVi: Dùng 'What I mean is' để làm rõ khái niệm tâm lý.

steps.chunk: That's why clearer durability labels and thriving second-hand markets are crucial to make greener choices effortless.
steps.meaningVi: Chốt bằng điều kiện giúp hành vi xanh dễ thực hiện hơn.

part23Frameworks.fullSampleAnswer: First and foremost, affordability plays a huge role: for students or families on tight budgets, sustainable brands can cost an arm and a leg. Another driver is relentless trend cycles on TikTok and Instagram, which create constant social pressure to appear in new outfits. What I mean is, people often care about the environment in principle, yet convenience wins at the checkout screen. That's why clearer durability labels and thriving second-hand markets are crucial to make greener choices effortless.
part23Frameworks.tipsVi: Tránh trả lời kiểu 'because people are greedy/lazy'; phân tích cấu trúc giá và tiếp thị sẽ cho thấy tư duy Band 8.0+.

part23Frameworks.question: Are university degrees still as valuable as they used to be?

steps.chunk: Generally speaking, a degree still opens doors, though it no longer guarantees a stable career the way it did for our parents' generation.
steps.meaningVi: So sánh tinh tế với thế hệ trước.

steps.stepLabel: 2. Lý do giảm tính độc quyền
steps.chunk: As university enrolment has expanded massively, employers increasingly look beyond diplomas toward portfolios, internships, and adaptability.
steps.meaningVi: Giải thích hiện tượng bão hòa bằng cấp một cách học thuật.

steps.stepLabel: 3. Giá trị của đào tạo nghề
steps.chunk: Meanwhile, skilled trades such as renewable-energy technicians and culinary chefs are in huge demand and often earn very competitive incomes.
steps.meaningVi: Mở rộng góc nhìn sang đào tạo nghề (vocational trades).

steps.chunk: So ultimately, a degree is worth pursuing when it aligns with clear career goals—not simply out of social habit.
steps.meaningVi: Kết câu gọn, sâu sắc.

part23Frameworks.fullSampleAnswer: Generally speaking, a degree still opens doors, though it no longer guarantees a stable career the way it did for our parents' generation. As university enrolment has expanded massively, employers increasingly look beyond diplomas toward portfolios, internships, and adaptability. Meanwhile, skilled trades such as renewable-energy technicians and culinary chefs are in huge demand and often earn very competitive incomes. So ultimately, a degree is worth pursuing when it aligns with clear career goals—not simply out of social habit.
part23Frameworks.tipsVi: Đưa ví dụ cụ thể về nghề kỹ thuật cao (renewable-energy technicians) giúp lập luận ủng hộ học nghề rất thuyết phục.

part23Frameworks.question: Should taxpayers' money be spent on museums and public art when hospitals and roads need funding?

steps.stepLabel: 1. Thừa nhận ưu tiên thiết yếu
steps.chunk: Obviously, essential services like healthcare, clean water, and schools must always come first in any public budget.
steps.meaningVi: Thừa nhận thứ tự ưu tiên hợp lý ngay từ đầu.

steps.stepLabel: 2. Lập luận bảo vệ văn hóa
steps.chunk: Having said that, treating culture as a luxury ignores how museums and galleries nurture civic identity, creativity, and mental wellbeing.
steps.meaningVi: Bảo vệ vai trò tinh thần và sáng tạo của nghệ thuật.

steps.stepLabel: 3. Giá trị kinh tế gián tiếp
steps.chunk: Moreover, iconic cultural landmarks attract international tourism and stimulate local cafes, hotels, and creative industries.
steps.meaningVi: Bổ sung lý do kinh tế thực dụng để tăng sức nặng.

steps.chunk: So allocating even a modest slice of funding to free public arts enriches society far beyond its price tag.
steps.meaningVi: Chốt bằng góc nhìn cân đối ngân sách.

part23Frameworks.fullSampleAnswer: Obviously, essential services like healthcare, clean water, and schools must always come first in any public budget. Having said that, treating culture as a luxury ignores how museums and galleries nurture civic identity, creativity, and mental wellbeing. Moreover, iconic cultural landmarks attract international tourism and stimulate local cafes, hotels, and creative industries. So allocating even a modest slice of funding to free public arts enriches society far beyond its price tag.
part23Frameworks.tipsVi: Đề ngân sách công rất hay lặp trong IELTS Speaking Part 3 & Writing Task 2; nhớ luôn tách 'essential services' và 'long-term cultural/economic returns'.

part23Frameworks.question: Why is workplace burnout becoming so widespread in modern economies?

steps.stepLabel: 1. Ranh giới mờ nhòa vì công nghệ
steps.chunk: A major culprit is the 'always-on' digital culture: work emails and chat apps follow employees straight into their living rooms at night.
steps.meaningVi: Dùng cụm 'always-on digital culture' mô tả chính xác hiện tượng.

steps.stepLabel: 2. Áp lực kinh tế & cạnh tranh
steps.chunk: On top of that, rising living costs and fierce job competition push many staff to accept unpaid overtime just to prove their commitment.
steps.meaningVi: Kết hợp nguyên nhân kinh tế và văn hóa doanh nghiệp.

steps.chunk: In finance and tech hubs, for example, taking a full lunch break is sometimes quietly frowned upon.
steps.meaningVi: Ví dụ sát thực tế ngành nghề.

steps.chunk: Unless companies enforce clear right-to-disconnect norms, chronic exhaustion ends up hurting productivity as much as employee health.
steps.meaningVi: Chốt bằng mệnh đề 'Unless...' nêu hệ quả ngược lại cho chính doanh nghiệp.

part23Frameworks.fullSampleAnswer: A major culprit is the 'always-on' digital culture: work emails and chat apps follow employees straight into their living rooms at night. On top of that, rising living costs and fierce job competition push many staff to accept unpaid overtime just to prove their commitment. In finance and tech hubs, for example, taking a full lunch break is sometimes quietly frowned upon. Unless companies enforce clear right-to-disconnect norms, chronic exhaustion ends up hurting productivity as much as employee health.
part23Frameworks.tipsVi: Cụm 'right-to-disconnect' (quyền ngắt kết nối ngoài giờ làm) là thuật ngữ hiện đại cực ghi điểm ở Part 3.

part23Frameworks.question: What are the advantages and disadvantages of relying on imported food?

steps.stepLabel: 1. Lợi ích cho người tiêu dùng
steps.chunk: On the one hand, global food trade gives shoppers year-round access to diverse fruits, spices, and affordable staples even during local droughts.
steps.meaningVi: Phân tích lợi ích đa dạng và an ninh nguồn cung.

steps.chunk: On the other hand, flying perishable produce across continents generates heavy carbon emissions and demands excessive cold-chain packaging.
steps.meaningVi: Chỉ rõ tác động phát thải vận chuyển (food miles).

steps.chunk: Furthermore, relying too heavily on imports leaves countries vulnerable whenever geopolitical conflicts or extreme weather disrupt shipping routes.
steps.meaningVi: Nâng tầm lập luận lên an ninh lương thực quốc gia.

steps.chunk: Consequently, encouraging seasonal local farming while keeping trade open for essentials strikes the healthiest balance.
steps.meaningVi: Chốt ý cân bằng, thực tế.

part23Frameworks.fullSampleAnswer: On the one hand, global food trade gives shoppers year-round access to diverse fruits, spices, and affordable staples even during local droughts. On the other hand, flying perishable produce across continents generates heavy carbon emissions and demands excessive cold-chain packaging. Furthermore, relying too heavily on imports leaves countries vulnerable whenever geopolitical conflicts or extreme weather disrupt shipping routes. Consequently, encouraging seasonal local farming while keeping trade open for essentials strikes the healthiest balance.
part23Frameworks.tipsVi: Từ vựng 'perishable produce' (nông sản dễ hỏng) và 'supply chain' giúp nâng cấp ngay lập tức bài nói chủ đề thực phẩm.

part23Frameworks.question: Do you think neighbours are less close today than they were in previous generations?

steps.chunk: Generally speaking, yes—especially in high-rise apartment blocks where people rush in and out on completely different schedules.
steps.meaningVi: Nêu thực tế đô thị hiện đại cụ thể.

steps.stepLabel: 2. Nguyên nhân di cư & tự chủ
steps.chunk: People relocate much more frequently for jobs nowadays, and digital delivery apps mean we rarely need to knock on a neighbour's door to borrow something.
steps.meaningVi: Giải thích nguyên nhân sâu sắc thay vì chỉ nói 'mọi người ích kỷ'.

steps.chunk: Having said that, neighbourhood warmth hasn't vanished entirely: resident group chats often rally quickly during storms or local charity drives.
steps.meaningVi: Nêu ngoại lệ tinh tế gắn với đời sống thực.

steps.chunk: If urban planners design more shared courtyards and pedestrian plazas, casual everyday friendships tend to blossom again naturally.
steps.meaningVi: Chốt bằng giải pháp kiến trúc đô thị rất giàu sức gợi.

part23Frameworks.fullSampleAnswer: Generally speaking, yes—especially in high-rise apartment blocks where people rush in and out on completely different schedules. People relocate much more frequently for jobs nowadays, and digital delivery apps mean we rarely need to knock on a neighbour's door to borrow something. Having said that, neighbourhood warmth hasn't vanished entirely: resident group chats often rally quickly during storms or local charity drives. If urban planners design more shared courtyards and pedestrian plazas, casual everyday friendships tend to blossom again naturally.
part23Frameworks.tipsVi: Mọi câu Part 3 nên kéo dài 4–6 câu theo khung: Nhận định → Nguyên nhân → Ví dụ/Ngoại lệ → Chốt ý (khoảng 35–45 giây).

pronunciationTraps.tipVi: Từ kết thúc bằng -ee luôn nhấn ngay âm cuối: gua-ran-TEE.
pronunciationTraps.exampleSentence: A university diploma alone can no longer guarantee instant employment.

pronunciationTraps.tipVi: Đuôi -eer luôn mang trọng âm chính: vol-un-TEER.
pronunciationTraps.exampleSentence: University students regularly volunteer to tutor children in rural areas.

pronunciationTraps.tipVi: Đuôi -eer kéo trọng âm về âm cuối: en-gi-NEER.
pronunciationTraps.exampleSentence: My older sister trained as a civil engineer specialising in flood defences.

pronunciationTraps.tipVi: Nhấn âm 1, đuôi -chase đọc nhẹ /tʃəs/: PUR-chəs.
pronunciationTraps.exampleSentence: Consumers increasingly check sustainability labels before making a purchase.

pronunciationTraps.tipVi: Nhấn âm 1, đuôi -pose đọc nhẹ /pəs/: PUR-pəs.
pronunciationTraps.exampleSentence: The primary purpose of public libraries is to keep knowledge accessible to all.

pronunciationTraps.commonError: Đọc sai âm đầu hoặc nhấn âm 2.
pronunciationTraps.tipVi: Anh-Anh đọc /ˈʃedjuːl/, Anh-Mỹ đọc /ˈskedʒuːl/; cả hai đều nhấn âm 1.
pronunciationTraps.exampleSentence: Flexible work hours let parents adjust their schedule around school runs.

pronunciationTraps.commonError: Đọc bật chữ p câm thành 're-sipt'.
pronunciationTraps.tipVi: Chữ p hoàn toàn câm, nhấn âm 2: re-CEET (/rɪˈsiːt/).
pronunciationTraps.exampleSentence: Always keep your digital receipt when booking flights online.

pronunciationTraps.commonError: Đọc bật chữ b câm thành 'sấp-tồ'.
pronunciationTraps.tipVi: Chữ b hoàn toàn câm, nhấn âm 1: SUT-tle (/ˈsʌtl/).
pronunciationTraps.exampleSentence: There is a subtle difference between healthy scepticism and total cynicism.

pronunciationTraps.tipVi: Gốc Pháp nên nhấn âm cuối dài /nɜː/: on-trə-prə-NUR.
pronunciationTraps.exampleSentence: A young local entrepreneur turned agricultural waste into eco-friendly packaging.
